The contract is capped at EUR 80k, the turnover selection criterion is explicitly N/A, no numeric minimum prior-reference or named-certification threshold was identified, and consortium/subcontracting is permitted. The work directly covers a Go backend, web dashboard and Flutter mobile app with maintenance, security, bug-fixing, compatibility and testing. Bidder-specific insurance, tax and delivery-capacity evidence prevent FINAL_SUPER_GREEN but do not constitute an established hard blocker to GREEN.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Provision of a Single Party Framework for the ongoing support, maintenance, and development of YourSpace Portals, associated websites, associated systems and associated services.
unknowns: Whether SPM alone meets EUR 100k turnover in each of the last three financial years
Whether SPM/partners can evidence three comparable contracts at the required scale
Whether required insurance levels or broker confirmations can be arranged
Whether two EU/EEA hosting facilities and required resources can be demonstrated
confirmed_supergreens.why: Excellent digital scope but the qualification burden is material. Viable as partner/consortium/reliance route if turnover, three comparable references, hosting and insurance gates can be covered; not a solo supergreen on current evidence.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Germany – IT services: consulting, software development, Internet and support – Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung Websites
confirmed_supergreens.buyer: Kulturveranstaltungen des Bundes in Berlin GmbH (KBB GmbH)
unknowns: Whether SPM/partners have three sufficiently strong Magnolia CMS references
Whether required ISMS/security capability and operational staffing can be demonstrated
Whether insurance requirements can be met
confirmed_supergreens.why: Strategically relevant web work but operationally enterprise-heavy and reference-driven. Three detailed Magnolia references determine selection into the top five; substantial cloud/security/operations burden makes this partner-heavy rather than lean-direct.

confirmed_supergreens.title: BPA - Pipe, Hose & Tubing PSC 4710, 4720, 4730
unknowns: Authoritative current submission timing is not resolved from the recovered DCE.
SPM has not evidenced relevant federal past performance or a compliant pipe/hose/tubing supplier route.
Domestic-content/origin and other federal supply clauses require item-level supplier validation.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Not a native SPM service, but unlike the other hot items it is potentially brokerable commodity supply. Keep only as a supplier/middleman investigation, not as a GREEN bid.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Defense Logistics Information Research (DLIR)
blockers: Retrieved authoritative material repeatedly states a 2021 BAA closing date while the live notice metadata says 2026-09-01; current submission authority is not reconciled.
The BAA is defense logistics R&D with technical/scientific review, detailed cost realism, DCAA/accounting representations and research-team expectations rather than a lean SPM service procurement.
Relevant prior research, technical papers, key personnel and detailed cost structure are integral to evaluation.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Interesting AI/RPA language produced a semantic false positive, but the current DCE evidence is both temporally conflicted and qualification-heavy defense R&D.

confirmed_supergreens.title: ULTRA-BROADBAND TERAHERTZ RADIO DEVELOPMENT
blockers: Advanced terahertz radio hardware/R&D program is not a lean SPM delivery scope.
DCE states the BAA is closed to foreign participation except limited fundamental-research exceptions and contains foreign-national/FOCI controls.
Security-risk review, senior/key-person disclosures and scientific/technical capability are material requirements.
confirmed_supergreens.why: A live open BAA, but fundamentally the wrong bidder and technical profile for SPM.

confirmed_supergreens.title: One Acquisition Solution for Integrated Services Plus (OASIS+) Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) Set-Aside Continuously Open Solicitation
blockers: This vehicle is explicitly an SDVOSB set-aside and requires qualification under that program for prime award.
The DCE contains extensive scored qualification, cybersecurity/supply-chain, reporting and contract-vehicle requirements well beyond a lean one-off SPM tender.
unknowns: No evidence in the tender-engine bidder profile establishes SPM as an eligible SDVOSB prime.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Potentially broad services, but the mandatory socioeconomic vehicle gate and heavy IDIQ qualification make it non-actionable for SPM on current evidence.

confirmed_supergreens.title: R--Region 6 Superfund Technical Assessment and Response Team (START) IV
blockers: The recovered DCE is a bridge justification for other than full and open competition covering July 2023-January 2024, not a current open competitive solicitation.
Mission scope is EPA Superfund emergency technical assessment/response, not SPM's lean digital/creative/broker core.
confirmed_supergreens.why: The hot queue treated substantive historical acquisition paperwork as live bid evidence.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Patient lifts and Installation
blockers: DCE is an only-one-responsible-source restricted-competition justification for Guldmann patient-lift equipment and installation.
Scope requires medical patient-lift hardware, structural installation/load testing and safe-patient-handling compliance, not SPM's lean core.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Medical equipment installation plus restricted-source procurement; not realistically executable by SPM as prime.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Jamaica Strategic Public Sector Transformation
blockers: Recovered material is broad project/procurement-plan context for a World Bank-financed public-sector transformation program, not a specific currently actionable solicitation with a submission deadline.
No specific SPM-fit deliverable, bidder gate set or submission package is established in the evidence.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Project-level procurement context was incorrectly promoted as a bid-ready tender.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Vendor Collaboration - MULTI-CENTER CLINICAL TRIALS OF NOVEL THERAPIES FOR PATIENTS WITH WELL CHARACTERIZED GASTROPARESIS
blockers: The DCE explicitly says this is not a procurement contract or grant for goods/services and that NIDDK provides no funds to selected collaborators.
It seeks clinical-research collaborators contributing therapeutic agents, devices, laboratory capability and research funding/resources.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Not a revenue tender at all; it is a clinical research collaboration opportunity.

confirmed_supergreens.title: J065--Zeiss Microscope Maintenance - NWI
blockers: Authoritative justification says maintenance must be performed by Zeiss-certified field engineers and identifies PROAIM as the only authorized Zeiss representative accepted for service/repair labor.
Recovered award material names PROAIM AMERICAS, LLC as awardee on 2026-08-14.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Already-awarded/single-source manufacturer-authorized maintenance, not a live SPM opportunity.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Explosive Trace Detection (ETD) Qualified Products List (QPL)
blockers: Applicant must provide production-representative explosive-trace-detection systems meeting TSA detection/functional standards and pass certification/qualification testing.
DCE contains classified/SSI handling, facility/personnel clearance and DD Form 254 requirements where applicable.
This is specialized security-screening hardware qualification, not an SPM service or brokerable generic supply tender.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Hard technical/security qualification makes this an obvious false positive.

EBVPD pildomas jį įkėlus į Europos Komisijos interneto svetainę https://ebvpd.eviesiejipirkimai.lt/espd-web/ ir užpildžius ir atsisiuntus pateikiamas su pasiūlymu. Atskirą EBVPD pildo: a) Tiekėjas; b) kiekvienas ūkio subjektų grupės narys (jeigu pasiūlymą teikia ūkio subjektų grupė); c) kiekvienas ūkio subjektas, jeigu tiekėjas remiasi jo pajėgumais, kad atitiktų reikalavimus Tiekėjams, išskyrus ekspertus, kurie pirkimo laimėjimo ir Pirkimo sutarties sudarymo atveju bus įdarbinti tiekėjo (šių ekspertų EBVPD teikti nereikia). Kvalifikaciją patvirtinančius dokumentus bus prašoma pateikti iš laimėtoju galinčio būti pripažinto Tiekėjo (jeigu SPS nėra nustatyta, kad šiuos dokumentus taip pat turi pateikti visi Tiekėjai kartu su pasiūlymu). confirmed_supergreens.title: Animation and Software Development
unknowns: SPM evidence of tax compliance must be available/acceptable
SPM must evidence appropriate insurance cover
Operational plan for onsite advisory in Ireland
confirmed_supergreens.why: Strong native SPM scope: creative direction, animation/AR assets, WebAR/app deployment, QR integration, mobile optimisation, testing and rollout. DCE shows no turnover, reference, certification or staffing threshold. Not FINAL_SUPER_GREEN because bidder-specific tax/insurance evidence remains unverified.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Provision of a Single Party Framework for the ongoing support, maintenance, and development of YourSpace Portals, associated websites, associated systems and associated services.
unknowns: Whether SPM alone meets EUR 100k turnover in each of the last three financial years
Whether SPM/partners can evidence three comparable contracts at the required scale
Whether required insurance levels or broker confirmations can be arranged
Whether two EU/EEA hosting facilities and required resources can be demonstrated
confirmed_supergreens.why: Excellent digital scope but the qualification burden is material. Viable as partner/consortium/reliance route if turnover, three comparable references, hosting and insurance gates can be covered; not a solo supergreen on current evidence.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Germany – IT services: consulting, software development, Internet and support – Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung Websites
confirmed_supergreens.buyer: Kulturveranstaltungen des Bundes in Berlin GmbH (KBB GmbH)
unknowns: Whether SPM/partners have three sufficiently strong Magnolia CMS references
Whether required ISMS/security capability and operational staffing can be demonstrated
Whether insurance requirements can be met
confirmed_supergreens.why: Strategically relevant web work but operationally enterprise-heavy and reference-driven. Three detailed Magnolia references determine selection into the top five; substantial cloud/security/operations burden makes this partner-heavy rather than lean-direct.

confirmed_supergreens.title: BPA - Pipe, Hose & Tubing PSC 4710, 4720, 4730
unknowns: Authoritative current submission timing is not resolved from the recovered DCE.
SPM has not evidenced relevant federal past performance or a compliant pipe/hose/tubing supplier route.
Domestic-content/origin and other federal supply clauses require item-level supplier validation.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Not a native SPM service, but unlike the other hot items it is potentially brokerable commodity supply. Keep only as a supplier/middleman investigation, not as a GREEN bid.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Defense Logistics Information Research (DLIR)
blockers: Retrieved authoritative material repeatedly states a 2021 BAA closing date while the live notice metadata says 2026-09-01; current submission authority is not reconciled.
The BAA is defense logistics R&D with technical/scientific review, detailed cost realism, DCAA/accounting representations and research-team expectations rather than a lean SPM service procurement.
Relevant prior research, technical papers, key personnel and detailed cost structure are integral to evaluation.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Interesting AI/RPA language produced a semantic false positive, but the current DCE evidence is both temporally conflicted and qualification-heavy defense R&D.

confirmed_supergreens.title: ULTRA-BROADBAND TERAHERTZ RADIO DEVELOPMENT
blockers: Advanced terahertz radio hardware/R&D program is not a lean SPM delivery scope.
DCE states the BAA is closed to foreign participation except limited fundamental-research exceptions and contains foreign-national/FOCI controls.
Security-risk review, senior/key-person disclosures and scientific/technical capability are material requirements.
confirmed_supergreens.why: A live open BAA, but fundamentally the wrong bidder and technical profile for SPM.

confirmed_supergreens.title: One Acquisition Solution for Integrated Services Plus (OASIS+) Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) Set-Aside Continuously Open Solicitation
blockers: This vehicle is explicitly an SDVOSB set-aside and requires qualification under that program for prime award.
The DCE contains extensive scored qualification, cybersecurity/supply-chain, reporting and contract-vehicle requirements well beyond a lean one-off SPM tender.
unknowns: No evidence in the tender-engine bidder profile establishes SPM as an eligible SDVOSB prime.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Potentially broad services, but the mandatory socioeconomic vehicle gate and heavy IDIQ qualification make it non-actionable for SPM on current evidence.

confirmed_supergreens.title: R--Region 6 Superfund Technical Assessment and Response Team (START) IV
blockers: The recovered DCE is a bridge justification for other than full and open competition covering July 2023-January 2024, not a current open competitive solicitation.
Mission scope is EPA Superfund emergency technical assessment/response, not SPM's lean digital/creative/broker core.
confirmed_supergreens.why: The hot queue treated substantive historical acquisition paperwork as live bid evidence.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Patient lifts and Installation
blockers: DCE is an only-one-responsible-source restricted-competition justification for Guldmann patient-lift equipment and installation.
Scope requires medical patient-lift hardware, structural installation/load testing and safe-patient-handling compliance, not SPM's lean core.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Medical equipment installation plus restricted-source procurement; not realistically executable by SPM as prime.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Jamaica Strategic Public Sector Transformation
blockers: Recovered material is broad project/procurement-plan context for a World Bank-financed public-sector transformation program, not a specific currently actionable solicitation with a submission deadline.
No specific SPM-fit deliverable, bidder gate set or submission package is established in the evidence.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Project-level procurement context was incorrectly promoted as a bid-ready tender.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Vendor Collaboration - MULTI-CENTER CLINICAL TRIALS OF NOVEL THERAPIES FOR PATIENTS WITH WELL CHARACTERIZED GASTROPARESIS
blockers: The DCE explicitly says this is not a procurement contract or grant for goods/services and that NIDDK provides no funds to selected collaborators.
It seeks clinical-research collaborators contributing therapeutic agents, devices, laboratory capability and research funding/resources.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Not a revenue tender at all; it is a clinical research collaboration opportunity.

confirmed_supergreens.title: J065--Zeiss Microscope Maintenance - NWI
blockers: Authoritative justification says maintenance must be performed by Zeiss-certified field engineers and identifies PROAIM as the only authorized Zeiss representative accepted for service/repair labor.
Recovered award material names PROAIM AMERICAS, LLC as awardee on 2026-08-14.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Already-awarded/single-source manufacturer-authorized maintenance, not a live SPM opportunity.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Explosive Trace Detection (ETD) Qualified Products List (QPL)
blockers: Applicant must provide production-representative explosive-trace-detection systems meeting TSA detection/functional standards and pass certification/qualification testing.
DCE contains classified/SSI handling, facility/personnel clearance and DD Form 254 requirements where applicable.
This is specialized security-screening hardware qualification, not an SPM service or brokerable generic supply tender.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Hard technical/security qualification makes this an obvious false positive.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Ireland – Computer support services – ICT services for the Operation and Maintenance of the Waters of LIFE Web Portal and Smart Phone Application
confirmed_supergreens.buyer: Department of Housing Local Government and Heritage
unknowns: SPM must confirm that its current insurance arrangements can meet the exact policy levels required by paragraph 2.21.1 or arrange compliant cover if awarded.

SPM must evidence a credible delivery team for the existing Go backend, web management dashboard and Flutter mobile application across the contract term; subcontracting/consortium is expressly available if specialist capacity is needed.
SPM must provide acceptable Irish tax-clearance evidence prior to award.
The existing system takeover and ongoing security/support obligations should be technically scoped before pricing to avoid underestimating maintenance effort.
confirmed_supergreens.why: This is a live, authoritative and unusually strong SPM-fit ICT maintenance opportunity. The DCE resolves the true tender deadline to 18 September 2026 at 17:00, while 11 September is only the query deadline. The contract is capped at EUR 80k, the turnover selection criterion is explicitly N/A, no numeric minimum prior-reference or named-certification threshold was identified, and consortium/subcontracting is permitted. The work directly covers a Go backend, web dashboard and Flutter mobile app with maintenance, security, bug-fixing, compatibility and testing. Bidder-specific insurance, tax and delivery-capacity evidence prevent FINAL_SUPER_GREEN but do not constitute an established hard blocker to GREEN.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Provision of a Single Party Framework for the ongoing support, maintenance, and development of YourSpace Portals, associated websites, associated systems and associated services.
unknowns: Whether SPM alone meets EUR 100k turnover in each of the last three financial years
Whether SPM/partners can evidence three comparable contracts at the required scale
Whether required insurance levels or broker confirmations can be arranged
Whether two EU/EEA hosting facilities and required resources can be demonstrated
confirmed_supergreens.why: Excellent digital scope but the qualification burden is material. Viable as partner/consortium/reliance route if turnover, three comparable references, hosting and insurance gates can be covered; not a solo supergreen on current evidence.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Germany – IT services: consulting, software development, Internet and support – Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung Websites
confirmed_supergreens.buyer: Kulturveranstaltungen des Bundes in Berlin GmbH (KBB GmbH)
unknowns: Whether SPM/partners have three sufficiently strong Magnolia CMS references
Whether required ISMS/security capability and operational staffing can be demonstrated
Whether insurance requirements can be met
confirmed_supergreens.why: Strategically relevant web work but operationally enterprise-heavy and reference-driven. Three detailed Magnolia references determine selection into the top five; substantial cloud/security/operations burden makes this partner-heavy rather than lean-direct.

confirmed_supergreens.title: BPA - Pipe, Hose & Tubing PSC 4710, 4720, 4730
unknowns: Authoritative current submission timing is not resolved from the recovered DCE.
SPM has not evidenced relevant federal past performance or a compliant pipe/hose/tubing supplier route.
Domestic-content/origin and other federal supply clauses require item-level supplier validation.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Not a native SPM service, but unlike the other hot items it is potentially brokerable commodity supply. Keep only as a supplier/middleman investigation, not as a GREEN bid.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Defense Logistics Information Research (DLIR)
blockers: Retrieved authoritative material repeatedly states a 2021 BAA closing date while the live notice metadata says 2026-09-01; current submission authority is not reconciled.
The BAA is defense logistics R&D with technical/scientific review, detailed cost realism, DCAA/accounting representations and research-team expectations rather than a lean SPM service procurement.
Relevant prior research, technical papers, key personnel and detailed cost structure are integral to evaluation.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Interesting AI/RPA language produced a semantic false positive, but the current DCE evidence is both temporally conflicted and qualification-heavy defense R&D.

confirmed_supergreens.title: ULTRA-BROADBAND TERAHERTZ RADIO DEVELOPMENT
blockers: Advanced terahertz radio hardware/R&D program is not a lean SPM delivery scope.
DCE states the BAA is closed to foreign participation except limited fundamental-research exceptions and contains foreign-national/FOCI controls.
Security-risk review, senior/key-person disclosures and scientific/technical capability are material requirements.
confirmed_supergreens.why: A live open BAA, but fundamentally the wrong bidder and technical profile for SPM.

confirmed_supergreens.title: One Acquisition Solution for Integrated Services Plus (OASIS+) Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) Set-Aside Continuously Open Solicitation
blockers: This vehicle is explicitly an SDVOSB set-aside and requires qualification under that program for prime award.
The DCE contains extensive scored qualification, cybersecurity/supply-chain, reporting and contract-vehicle requirements well beyond a lean one-off SPM tender.
unknowns: No evidence in the tender-engine bidder profile establishes SPM as an eligible SDVOSB prime.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Potentially broad services, but the mandatory socioeconomic vehicle gate and heavy IDIQ qualification make it non-actionable for SPM on current evidence.

confirmed_supergreens.title: R--Region 6 Superfund Technical Assessment and Response Team (START) IV
blockers: The recovered DCE is a bridge justification for other than full and open competition covering July 2023-January 2024, not a current open competitive solicitation.
Mission scope is EPA Superfund emergency technical assessment/response, not SPM's lean digital/creative/broker core.
confirmed_supergreens.why: The hot queue treated substantive historical acquisition paperwork as live bid evidence.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Patient lifts and Installation
blockers: DCE is an only-one-responsible-source restricted-competition justification for Guldmann patient-lift equipment and installation.
Scope requires medical patient-lift hardware, structural installation/load testing and safe-patient-handling compliance, not SPM's lean core.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Medical equipment installation plus restricted-source procurement; not realistically executable by SPM as prime.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Jamaica Strategic Public Sector Transformation
blockers: Recovered material is broad project/procurement-plan context for a World Bank-financed public-sector transformation program, not a specific currently actionable solicitation with a submission deadline.
No specific SPM-fit deliverable, bidder gate set or submission package is established in the evidence.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Project-level procurement context was incorrectly promoted as a bid-ready tender.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Vendor Collaboration - MULTI-CENTER CLINICAL TRIALS OF NOVEL THERAPIES FOR PATIENTS WITH WELL CHARACTERIZED GASTROPARESIS
blockers: The DCE explicitly says this is not a procurement contract or grant for goods/services and that NIDDK provides no funds to selected collaborators.
It seeks clinical-research collaborators contributing therapeutic agents, devices, laboratory capability and research funding/resources.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Not a revenue tender at all; it is a clinical research collaboration opportunity.

confirmed_supergreens.title: J065--Zeiss Microscope Maintenance - NWI
blockers: Authoritative justification says maintenance must be performed by Zeiss-certified field engineers and identifies PROAIM as the only authorized Zeiss representative accepted for service/repair labor.
Recovered award material names PROAIM AMERICAS, LLC as awardee on 2026-08-14.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Already-awarded/single-source manufacturer-authorized maintenance, not a live SPM opportunity.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Explosive Trace Detection (ETD) Qualified Products List (QPL)
blockers: Applicant must provide production-representative explosive-trace-detection systems meeting TSA detection/functional standards and pass certification/qualification testing.
DCE contains classified/SSI handling, facility/personnel clearance and DD Form 254 requirements where applicable.
This is specialized security-screening hardware qualification, not an SPM service or brokerable generic supply tender.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Hard technical/security qualification makes this an obvious false positive.

The existing system takeover and ongoing security/support obligations should be technically scoped before pricing to avoid underestimating maintenance effort.
confirmed_supergreens.why: This is a live, authoritative and unusually strong SPM-fit ICT maintenance opportunity. The DCE resolves the true tender deadline to 18 September 2026 at 17:00, while 11 September is only the query deadline. The contract is capped at EUR 80k, the turnover selection criterion is explicitly N/A, no numeric minimum prior-reference or named-certification threshold was identified, and consortium/subcontracting is permitted. The work directly covers a Go backend, web dashboard and Flutter mobile app with maintenance, security, bug-fixing, compatibility and testing. Bidder-specific insurance, tax and delivery-capacity evidence prevent FINAL_SUPER_GREEN but do not constitute an established hard blocker to GREEN.

unknowns: Whether SPM alone meets EUR 100k turnover in each of the last three financial years

Auf besondere Anforderung hat er die Nachunternehmer namentlich mit Adresse zu benennen und ent- sprechende Eignungsunterlagen und Kalkulationen vorzulegen. Einzelheiten ergeben sich aus den Vergabeunter- lagen. Die Benennung hat auf dem Formular “Nachunternehmerverzeichnis“ zu erfolgen. Die benannten Nachunter- nehmer haben ihrerseits die Übernahme der Leistungen auf dem Formular „Verpflichtungserklärung“ zu bestäti- gen. Beabsichtigt der Bieter, im Hinblick auf die erforderliche wirtschaftliche und finanzielle sowie die technische und berufliche Leistungsfähigkeit die Kapazitäten anderer Unternehmer in Anspruch zu nehmen (Eignungsleihe), hat er mit dem Angebot den Nachweis zu führen, dass ihm die für den Auftrag erforderlichen Mittel tatsächlich zur Verfügung stehen. unknowns: SPM evidence of tax compliance must be available/acceptable
SPM must evidence appropriate insurance cover
Operational plan for onsite advisory in Ireland
confirmed_supergreens.why: Strong native SPM scope: creative direction, animation/AR assets, WebAR/app deployment, QR integration, mobile optimisation, testing and rollout. DCE shows no turnover, reference, certification or staffing threshold. Not FINAL_SUPER_GREEN because bidder-specific tax/insurance evidence remains unverified.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Provision of a Single Party Framework for the ongoing support, maintenance, and development of YourSpace Portals, associated websites, associated systems and associated services.
unknowns: Whether SPM alone meets EUR 100k turnover in each of the last three financial years
Whether SPM/partners can evidence three comparable contracts at the required scale
Whether required insurance levels or broker confirmations can be arranged
Whether two EU/EEA hosting facilities and required resources can be demonstrated
confirmed_supergreens.why: Excellent digital scope but the qualification burden is material. Viable as partner/consortium/reliance route if turnover, three comparable references, hosting and insurance gates can be covered; not a solo supergreen on current evidence.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Germany – IT services: consulting, software development, Internet and support – Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung Websites
confirmed_supergreens.buyer: Kulturveranstaltungen des Bundes in Berlin GmbH (KBB GmbH)
unknowns: Whether SPM/partners have three sufficiently strong Magnolia CMS references
Whether required ISMS/security capability and operational staffing can be demonstrated
Whether insurance requirements can be met
confirmed_supergreens.why: Strategically relevant web work but operationally enterprise-heavy and reference-driven. Three detailed Magnolia references determine selection into the top five; substantial cloud/security/operations burden makes this partner-heavy rather than lean-direct.

confirmed_supergreens.title: BPA - Pipe, Hose & Tubing PSC 4710, 4720, 4730
unknowns: Authoritative current submission timing is not resolved from the recovered DCE.
SPM has not evidenced relevant federal past performance or a compliant pipe/hose/tubing supplier route.
Domestic-content/origin and other federal supply clauses require item-level supplier validation.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Not a native SPM service, but unlike the other hot items it is potentially brokerable commodity supply. Keep only as a supplier/middleman investigation, not as a GREEN bid.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Defense Logistics Information Research (DLIR)
blockers: Retrieved authoritative material repeatedly states a 2021 BAA closing date while the live notice metadata says 2026-09-01; current submission authority is not reconciled.
The BAA is defense logistics R&D with technical/scientific review, detailed cost realism, DCAA/accounting representations and research-team expectations rather than a lean SPM service procurement.
Relevant prior research, technical papers, key personnel and detailed cost structure are integral to evaluation.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Interesting AI/RPA language produced a semantic false positive, but the current DCE evidence is both temporally conflicted and qualification-heavy defense R&D.

confirmed_supergreens.title: ULTRA-BROADBAND TERAHERTZ RADIO DEVELOPMENT
blockers: Advanced terahertz radio hardware/R&D program is not a lean SPM delivery scope.
DCE states the BAA is closed to foreign participation except limited fundamental-research exceptions and contains foreign-national/FOCI controls.
Security-risk review, senior/key-person disclosures and scientific/technical capability are material requirements.
confirmed_supergreens.why: A live open BAA, but fundamentally the wrong bidder and technical profile for SPM.

confirmed_supergreens.title: One Acquisition Solution for Integrated Services Plus (OASIS+) Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) Set-Aside Continuously Open Solicitation
blockers: This vehicle is explicitly an SDVOSB set-aside and requires qualification under that program for prime award.
The DCE contains extensive scored qualification, cybersecurity/supply-chain, reporting and contract-vehicle requirements well beyond a lean one-off SPM tender.
unknowns: No evidence in the tender-engine bidder profile establishes SPM as an eligible SDVOSB prime.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Potentially broad services, but the mandatory socioeconomic vehicle gate and heavy IDIQ qualification make it non-actionable for SPM on current evidence.

confirmed_supergreens.title: R--Region 6 Superfund Technical Assessment and Response Team (START) IV
blockers: The recovered DCE is a bridge justification for other than full and open competition covering July 2023-January 2024, not a current open competitive solicitation.
Mission scope is EPA Superfund emergency technical assessment/response, not SPM's lean digital/creative/broker core.
confirmed_supergreens.why: The hot queue treated substantive historical acquisition paperwork as live bid evidence.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Patient lifts and Installation
blockers: DCE is an only-one-responsible-source restricted-competition justification for Guldmann patient-lift equipment and installation.
Scope requires medical patient-lift hardware, structural installation/load testing and safe-patient-handling compliance, not SPM's lean core.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Medical equipment installation plus restricted-source procurement; not realistically executable by SPM as prime.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Jamaica Strategic Public Sector Transformation
blockers: Recovered material is broad project/procurement-plan context for a World Bank-financed public-sector transformation program, not a specific currently actionable solicitation with a submission deadline.
No specific SPM-fit deliverable, bidder gate set or submission package is established in the evidence.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Project-level procurement context was incorrectly promoted as a bid-ready tender.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Vendor Collaboration - MULTI-CENTER CLINICAL TRIALS OF NOVEL THERAPIES FOR PATIENTS WITH WELL CHARACTERIZED GASTROPARESIS
blockers: The DCE explicitly says this is not a procurement contract or grant for goods/services and that NIDDK provides no funds to selected collaborators.
It seeks clinical-research collaborators contributing therapeutic agents, devices, laboratory capability and research funding/resources.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Not a revenue tender at all; it is a clinical research collaboration opportunity.

confirmed_supergreens.title: J065--Zeiss Microscope Maintenance - NWI
blockers: Authoritative justification says maintenance must be performed by Zeiss-certified field engineers and identifies PROAIM as the only authorized Zeiss representative accepted for service/repair labor.
Recovered award material names PROAIM AMERICAS, LLC as awardee on 2026-08-14.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Already-awarded/single-source manufacturer-authorized maintenance, not a live SPM opportunity.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Explosive Trace Detection (ETD) Qualified Products List (QPL)
blockers: Applicant must provide production-representative explosive-trace-detection systems meeting TSA detection/functional standards and pass certification/qualification testing.
DCE contains classified/SSI handling, facility/personnel clearance and DD Form 254 requirements where applicable.
This is specialized security-screening hardware qualification, not an SPM service or brokerable generic supply tender.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Hard technical/security qualification makes this an obvious false positive.

Sämtliche Informationen zum Verfahren sind auf dem Vergabemarktplatz hinterlegt (Bekanntmachungsinformationen, Teilnahme-/Vergabeunterlagen und die Kommunikation). Elektronische Interessensbestätigungen/Teilnahmeanträge/Angebote können – vorbehaltlich abweichender Angaben im konkreten Verfahren – grundsätzlich auf drei Arten eingereicht werden: 1) Einreichung in Textform nach § 126b BGB 2) Einreichung mit fortgeschrittener elektronischer Signatur bzw. fortgeschrittenem elektronischen Siegel 3) Einreichung mit qualifizierter elektronischer Signatur bzw. qualifiziertem elektronischen Siegel Weitere Informationen zu den Signaturen, zum Bietertool und zum technischen Betrieb stehen Ihnen unter www.vergabe.nrw.de im Bereich Wirtschaft/Einkauf NRW/Vergabemarktplatz und insbesondere unter https://support.cosinex.de/unternehmen/ zur Verfügung. In allen drei Fällen erfolgen das Hochladen, die Verschlüsselung der Interessensbestätigung, des Teilnahmeantrags/Angebotes und die Weiterleitung mit dem vom Vergabemarktplatz NRW zur Verfügung gestellten Bietertool. Das Hochladen ist nur bis zum Ablauf der in der Auftragsbekanntmachung bzw. dem Anschreiben genannten Teilnahme-/Angebotsfrist möglich. lgen das Hochladen, die Verschlüsselung der Interessensbestätigung, des Teilnahmeantrags/Angebotes und die Weiterleitung mit dem vom Vergabemarktplatz NRW zur Verfügung gestellten Bietertool. confirmed_supergreens.title: Animation and Software Development
unknowns: SPM evidence of tax compliance must be available/acceptable
SPM must evidence appropriate insurance cover
Operational plan for onsite advisory in Ireland
confirmed_supergreens.why: Strong native SPM scope: creative direction, animation/AR assets, WebAR/app deployment, QR integration, mobile optimisation, testing and rollout. DCE shows no turnover, reference, certification or staffing threshold. Not FINAL_SUPER_GREEN because bidder-specific tax/insurance evidence remains unverified.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Provision of a Single Party Framework for the ongoing support, maintenance, and development of YourSpace Portals, associated websites, associated systems and associated services.
unknowns: Whether SPM alone meets EUR 100k turnover in each of the last three financial years
Whether SPM/partners can evidence three comparable contracts at the required scale
Whether required insurance levels or broker confirmations can be arranged
Whether two EU/EEA hosting facilities and required resources can be demonstrated
confirmed_supergreens.why: Excellent digital scope but the qualification burden is material. Viable as partner/consortium/reliance route if turnover, three comparable references, hosting and insurance gates can be covered; not a solo supergreen on current evidence.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Germany – IT services: consulting, software development, Internet and support – Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung Websites
confirmed_supergreens.buyer: Kulturveranstaltungen des Bundes in Berlin GmbH (KBB GmbH)
unknowns: Whether SPM/partners have three sufficiently strong Magnolia CMS references
Whether required ISMS/security capability and operational staffing can be demonstrated
Whether insurance requirements can be met
confirmed_supergreens.why: Strategically relevant web work but operationally enterprise-heavy and reference-driven. Three detailed Magnolia references determine selection into the top five; substantial cloud/security/operations burden makes this partner-heavy rather than lean-direct.

confirmed_supergreens.title: BPA - Pipe, Hose & Tubing PSC 4710, 4720, 4730
unknowns: Authoritative current submission timing is not resolved from the recovered DCE.
SPM has not evidenced relevant federal past performance or a compliant pipe/hose/tubing supplier route.
Domestic-content/origin and other federal supply clauses require item-level supplier validation.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Not a native SPM service, but unlike the other hot items it is potentially brokerable commodity supply. Keep only as a supplier/middleman investigation, not as a GREEN bid.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Defense Logistics Information Research (DLIR)
blockers: Retrieved authoritative material repeatedly states a 2021 BAA closing date while the live notice metadata says 2026-09-01; current submission authority is not reconciled.
The BAA is defense logistics R&D with technical/scientific review, detailed cost realism, DCAA/accounting representations and research-team expectations rather than a lean SPM service procurement.
Relevant prior research, technical papers, key personnel and detailed cost structure are integral to evaluation.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Interesting AI/RPA language produced a semantic false positive, but the current DCE evidence is both temporally conflicted and qualification-heavy defense R&D.

confirmed_supergreens.title: ULTRA-BROADBAND TERAHERTZ RADIO DEVELOPMENT
blockers: Advanced terahertz radio hardware/R&D program is not a lean SPM delivery scope.
DCE states the BAA is closed to foreign participation except limited fundamental-research exceptions and contains foreign-national/FOCI controls.
Security-risk review, senior/key-person disclosures and scientific/technical capability are material requirements.
confirmed_supergreens.why: A live open BAA, but fundamentally the wrong bidder and technical profile for SPM.

confirmed_supergreens.title: One Acquisition Solution for Integrated Services Plus (OASIS+) Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) Set-Aside Continuously Open Solicitation
blockers: This vehicle is explicitly an SDVOSB set-aside and requires qualification under that program for prime award.
The DCE contains extensive scored qualification, cybersecurity/supply-chain, reporting and contract-vehicle requirements well beyond a lean one-off SPM tender.
unknowns: No evidence in the tender-engine bidder profile establishes SPM as an eligible SDVOSB prime.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Potentially broad services, but the mandatory socioeconomic vehicle gate and heavy IDIQ qualification make it non-actionable for SPM on current evidence.

confirmed_supergreens.title: R--Region 6 Superfund Technical Assessment and Response Team (START) IV
blockers: The recovered DCE is a bridge justification for other than full and open competition covering July 2023-January 2024, not a current open competitive solicitation.
Mission scope is EPA Superfund emergency technical assessment/response, not SPM's lean digital/creative/broker core.
confirmed_supergreens.why: The hot queue treated substantive historical acquisition paperwork as live bid evidence.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Patient lifts and Installation
blockers: DCE is an only-one-responsible-source restricted-competition justification for Guldmann patient-lift equipment and installation.
Scope requires medical patient-lift hardware, structural installation/load testing and safe-patient-handling compliance, not SPM's lean core.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Medical equipment installation plus restricted-source procurement; not realistically executable by SPM as prime.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Jamaica Strategic Public Sector Transformation
blockers: Recovered material is broad project/procurement-plan context for a World Bank-financed public-sector transformation program, not a specific currently actionable solicitation with a submission deadline.
No specific SPM-fit deliverable, bidder gate set or submission package is established in the evidence.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Project-level procurement context was incorrectly promoted as a bid-ready tender.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Vendor Collaboration - MULTI-CENTER CLINICAL TRIALS OF NOVEL THERAPIES FOR PATIENTS WITH WELL CHARACTERIZED GASTROPARESIS
blockers: The DCE explicitly says this is not a procurement contract or grant for goods/services and that NIDDK provides no funds to selected collaborators.
It seeks clinical-research collaborators contributing therapeutic agents, devices, laboratory capability and research funding/resources.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Not a revenue tender at all; it is a clinical research collaboration opportunity.

confirmed_supergreens.title: J065--Zeiss Microscope Maintenance - NWI
blockers: Authoritative justification says maintenance must be performed by Zeiss-certified field engineers and identifies PROAIM as the only authorized Zeiss representative accepted for service/repair labor.
Recovered award material names PROAIM AMERICAS, LLC as awardee on 2026-08-14.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Already-awarded/single-source manufacturer-authorized maintenance, not a live SPM opportunity.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Explosive Trace Detection (ETD) Qualified Products List (QPL)
blockers: Applicant must provide production-representative explosive-trace-detection systems meeting TSA detection/functional standards and pass certification/qualification testing.
DCE contains classified/SSI handling, facility/personnel clearance and DD Form 254 requirements where applicable.
This is specialized security-screening hardware qualification, not an SPM service or brokerable generic supply tender.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Hard technical/security qualification makes this an obvious false positive.

Inhaltlich muss die Vollmacht dem § 29 Abs. 7 VSVgV entsprechen; eine Liste aller Mitglieder ist beizufügen. Der Bevollmächtigte ist alleiniger An- sprechpartner der Vergabestelle. Etwaige Ausschlussgründe eines Mit- glieds führen zum Ausschluss der Bietergemeinschaft.  Die für die technische und berufliche Leistungsfähigkeit aufgestellten Krite- rien müssen von jedem Mitglied der Bietergemeinschaft einzeln erfüllt sein, und zwar jeweils im Hinblick auf den Leistungsanteil der einzelnen Mitglie- der. Eine kumulative Gesamtbetrachtung der Bietergemeinschaft findet nicht statt. Etwaige Ausschlussgründe eines Mitglieds führen zum Aus- schluss der Bietergemeinschaft. unknowns: Whether SPM/partners have three sufficiently strong Magnolia CMS references

confirmed_supergreens.title: BPA - Pipe, Hose & Tubing PSC 4710, 4720, 4730
unknowns: Authoritative current submission timing is not resolved from the recovered DCE.
SPM has not evidenced relevant federal past performance or a compliant pipe/hose/tubing supplier route.
Domestic-content/origin and other federal supply clauses require item-level supplier validation.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Not a native SPM service, but unlike the other hot items it is potentially brokerable commodity supply. Keep only as a supplier/middleman investigation, not as a GREEN bid.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Defense Logistics Information Research (DLIR)
blockers: Retrieved authoritative material repeatedly states a 2021 BAA closing date while the live notice metadata says 2026-09-01; current submission authority is not reconciled.
The BAA is defense logistics R&D with technical/scientific review, detailed cost realism, DCAA/accounting representations and research-team expectations rather than a lean SPM service procurement.
Relevant prior research, technical papers, key personnel and detailed cost structure are integral to evaluation.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Interesting AI/RPA language produced a semantic false positive, but the current DCE evidence is both temporally conflicted and qualification-heavy defense R&D.

confirmed_supergreens.title: ULTRA-BROADBAND TERAHERTZ RADIO DEVELOPMENT
blockers: Advanced terahertz radio hardware/R&D program is not a lean SPM delivery scope.
DCE states the BAA is closed to foreign participation except limited fundamental-research exceptions and contains foreign-national/FOCI controls.
Security-risk review, senior/key-person disclosures and scientific/technical capability are material requirements.
confirmed_supergreens.why: A live open BAA, but fundamentally the wrong bidder and technical profile for SPM.

confirmed_supergreens.title: One Acquisition Solution for Integrated Services Plus (OASIS+) Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) Set-Aside Continuously Open Solicitation
blockers: This vehicle is explicitly an SDVOSB set-aside and requires qualification under that program for prime award.
The DCE contains extensive scored qualification, cybersecurity/supply-chain, reporting and contract-vehicle requirements well beyond a lean one-off SPM tender.
unknowns: No evidence in the tender-engine bidder profile establishes SPM as an eligible SDVOSB prime.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Potentially broad services, but the mandatory socioeconomic vehicle gate and heavy IDIQ qualification make it non-actionable for SPM on current evidence.

confirmed_supergreens.title: R--Region 6 Superfund Technical Assessment and Response Team (START) IV
blockers: The recovered DCE is a bridge justification for other than full and open competition covering July 2023-January 2024, not a current open competitive solicitation.
Mission scope is EPA Superfund emergency technical assessment/response, not SPM's lean digital/creative/broker core.
confirmed_supergreens.why: The hot queue treated substantive historical acquisition paperwork as live bid evidence.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Patient lifts and Installation
blockers: DCE is an only-one-responsible-source restricted-competition justification for Guldmann patient-lift equipment and installation.
Scope requires medical patient-lift hardware, structural installation/load testing and safe-patient-handling compliance, not SPM's lean core.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Medical equipment installation plus restricted-source procurement; not realistically executable by SPM as prime.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Jamaica Strategic Public Sector Transformation
blockers: Recovered material is broad project/procurement-plan context for a World Bank-financed public-sector transformation program, not a specific currently actionable solicitation with a submission deadline.
No specific SPM-fit deliverable, bidder gate set or submission package is established in the evidence.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Project-level procurement context was incorrectly promoted as a bid-ready tender.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Vendor Collaboration - MULTI-CENTER CLINICAL TRIALS OF NOVEL THERAPIES FOR PATIENTS WITH WELL CHARACTERIZED GASTROPARESIS
blockers: The DCE explicitly says this is not a procurement contract or grant for goods/services and that NIDDK provides no funds to selected collaborators.
It seeks clinical-research collaborators contributing therapeutic agents, devices, laboratory capability and research funding/resources.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Not a revenue tender at all; it is a clinical research collaboration opportunity.

confirmed_supergreens.title: J065--Zeiss Microscope Maintenance - NWI
blockers: Authoritative justification says maintenance must be performed by Zeiss-certified field engineers and identifies PROAIM as the only authorized Zeiss representative accepted for service/repair labor.
Recovered award material names PROAIM AMERICAS, LLC as awardee on 2026-08-14.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Already-awarded/single-source manufacturer-authorized maintenance, not a live SPM opportunity.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Explosive Trace Detection (ETD) Qualified Products List (QPL)
blockers: Applicant must provide production-representative explosive-trace-detection systems meeting TSA detection/functional standards and pass certification/qualification testing.
DCE contains classified/SSI handling, facility/personnel clearance and DD Form 254 requirements where applicable.
This is specialized security-screening hardware qualification, not an SPM service or brokerable generic supply tender.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Hard technical/security qualification makes this an obvious false positive.

Ferner enthält das Angebot für die genannten Einzelleistungen jeweils eine kurze Zusammenfassung über den genauen Gegenstand und die geplante Umsetzungsstrategie der Entwicklung, die Liefer- und Zahlungszeiträume sowie die konkrete Form der zu liefernden Entwicklungsobjekte (z.B.: ein einzelnes Software-Inkrement, SQL-Skripte, Dokumentationen, etc.). Bei Bedarf kann der AG mit dem AN im Rahmen einer Verhandlungsrunde über die Art und Weise der Umsetzung und die Höhe der zugrundeliegenden Stundenanzahl verhandeln. Hierbei wird mindestens Folgendes erwartet: a) eine nachvollziehbare Darstellung zur geplanten Vorgehensweise bei der Einarbeitung in die komplette Fachanwendung einschließlich des Quellcodes (ggfs. unter Einsatz von Analysewerkzeugen), des Systemrahmenkonzepts (technische Details zu ISGA-Portal) und des Styleguides (UX- und Baustein-Leitfaden). b) ein entsprechender Zeitplan mit wesentlichen Meilensteinen für die Einarbeitungszeit. c) eine plausible Darstellung für die Qualitätssicherung des erarbeiteten Kenntnisstandes des Teams vor Beginn der Leistungserbringung. d) Gestaltung der Einarbeitung in ISGA-Portal und ISGA-alt sowie die grundlegendsten Strukturen und fachlichen Aspekte der Gewerbeaufsicht in Rheinland-Pfalz. confirmed_supergreens.title: Ireland – Computer support services – ICT services for the Operation and Maintenance of the Waters of LIFE Web Portal and Smart Phone Application
confirmed_supergreens.buyer: Department of Housing Local Government and Heritage
unknowns: SPM must confirm that its current insurance arrangements can meet the exact policy levels required by paragraph 2.21.1 or arrange compliant cover if awarded.

SPM must evidence a credible delivery team for the existing Go backend, web management dashboard and Flutter mobile application across the contract term; subcontracting/consortium is expressly available if specialist capacity is needed.
SPM must provide acceptable Irish tax-clearance evidence prior to award.
The existing system takeover and ongoing security/support obligations should be technically scoped before pricing to avoid underestimating maintenance effort.
confirmed_supergreens.why: This is a live, authoritative and unusually strong SPM-fit ICT maintenance opportunity. The DCE resolves the true tender deadline to 18 September 2026 at 17:00, while 11 September is only the query deadline. The contract is capped at EUR 80k, the turnover selection criterion is explicitly N/A, no numeric minimum prior-reference or named-certification threshold was identified, and consortium/subcontracting is permitted. The work directly covers a Go backend, web dashboard and Flutter mobile app with maintenance, security, bug-fixing, compatibility and testing. Bidder-specific insurance, tax and delivery-capacity evidence prevent FINAL_SUPER_GREEN but do not constitute an established hard blocker to GREEN.

unknowns: Exact minimum level, if any, attached to professional references/capacity must be confirmed

Participation is not reserved, capacity from other economic operators may be relied upon with written commitment, electronic tender submission is supported and payment is on a 30-day university cycle. Physical capture in Herault and remaining bidder-capacity proof keep it just below GREEN.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Ireland – Computer support services – ICT services for the Operation and Maintenance of the Waters of LIFE Web Portal and Smart Phone Application
confirmed_supergreens.buyer: Department of Housing Local Government and Heritage
unknowns: SPM must confirm that its current insurance arrangements can meet the exact policy levels required by paragraph 2.21.1 or arrange compliant cover if awarded.

SPM must evidence a credible delivery team for the existing Go backend, web management dashboard and Flutter mobile application across the contract term; subcontracting/consortium is expressly available if specialist capacity is needed.
SPM must provide acceptable Irish tax-clearance evidence prior to award.
The existing system takeover and ongoing security/support obligations should be technically scoped before pricing to avoid underestimating maintenance effort.
confirmed_supergreens.why: This is a live, authoritative and unusually strong SPM-fit ICT maintenance opportunity. The DCE resolves the true tender deadline to 18 September 2026 at 17:00, while 11 September is only the query deadline. The contract is capped at EUR 80k, the turnover selection criterion is explicitly N/A, no numeric minimum prior-reference or named-certification threshold was identified, and consortium/subcontracting is permitted. The work directly covers a Go backend, web dashboard and Flutter mobile app with maintenance, security, bug-fixing, compatibility and testing. Bidder-specific insurance, tax and delivery-capacity evidence prevent FINAL_SUPER_GREEN but do not constitute an established hard blocker to GREEN.

confirmed_supergreens.title: France – Motion picture and video services – Prestations de captation vidéo, de production audiovisuelle (avec ou sans scénarisation), de post-production et de réalisation de supports vidéo accessibles pour le compte de l’université de Montpellier Paul-Valéry
unknowns: Exact minimum level, if any, attached to professional references/capacity must be confirmed
SPM needs a credible local/on-site capture crew and civil-liability insurance evidence
confirmed_supergreens.why: Strong new SPM-fit audiovisual opportunity. Two lots cover video capture/production and accessible video; the scope expressly includes post-production, transfer of rushes and all versions, and motion-design/interactive integration. Participation is not reserved, capacity from other economic operators may be relied upon with written commitment, electronic tender submission is supported and payment is on a 30-day university cycle. Physical capture in Herault and remaining bidder-capacity proof keep it just below GREEN.

This is commercially attractive, but supplier execution and exact qualification gates remain material dependencies.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Ireland – Website and App Accessibility Audit Solution

confirmed_supergreens.title: Website and App Accessibility Audit Solution

unknowns: Exact technical/reference and sample requirements per lot need final verification

confirmed_supergreens.why: Open two-lot printing framework with unit-price ordering and long bid runway. The DCE asks for turnover information for up to the last three available financial years and technical-capacity declarations, but the compact evidence does not establish a disqualifying numeric turnover threshold. Strong print-broker candidate, but supplier economics and exact lot gates remain unresolved.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Design, layout and printing of Department of Agriculture five-year report
confirmed_supergreens.why: Hidden gem: DCE explicitly asks for design, layout and printing of the five-year report. Directly brokerable with AI/design plus print subcontractor. Main friction is South African administration and apparent physical quotation-box submission in Pretoria.

unknowns: Exact minimum-turnover amount and lot-specific financial-capacity proof must be fully reconciled

confirmed_supergreens.title: AI Technologies for Procurement Modernization Commercial Solutions Opening

confirmed_supergreens.title: France – Impression des supports de communication de Beaucaire Terre d'Argence
confirmed_supergreens.why: Straight printing of communication supports. Strong middleman/print-broker lane with long runway, but compact gate extraction is insufficient to declare GREEN before volumes, samples/references and delivery requirements are checked.

confirmed_supergreens.title: France – Graphic design services – Prestations de conseil en communication, conception graphique et editoriale, fabrication de supports et totems de communication, dans le cadre du projet ecocampus
unknowns: Exact lot-specific technical/reference minimums and fabrication logistics remain to be proven
SPM needs a credible physical fabrication/installation route for supports and totems
confirmed_supergreens.why: Open French framework combining communication advice, graphic/editorial design and fabrication. Creative work is a strong fit, but physical-support/totem delivery and reference/capacity evidence prevent a clean GREEN today.

confirmed_supergreens.title: RFP-HO-06-2026 – Brand Strategist

confirmed_supergreens.title: Poland – Modernizacja systemów ochrony środowiska z API i udostępnieniem danych

Strong partnerable opportunity with a Unit4 implementer.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Belgium – Supply chain traceability services and forced labour risk detection pilots

confirmed_supergreens.title: TEGUC communications / outreach requirement

confirmed_supergreens.title: Germany – IT services: consulting, software development, Internet and support – Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung Websites
confirmed_supergreens.buyer: Kulturveranstaltungen des Bundes in Berlin GmbH (KBB GmbH)
unknowns: Whether SPM/partners have three sufficiently strong Magnolia CMS references
Whether required ISMS/security capability and operational staffing can be demonstrated
Whether insurance requirements can be met
confirmed_supergreens.why: Strategically relevant web work but operationally enterprise-heavy and reference-driven. Three detailed Magnolia references determine selection into the top five; substantial cloud/security/operations burden makes this partner-heavy rather than lean-direct.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Belgium – GitLab Enterprise Premium Self-Managed licensing
confirmed_supergreens.why: Potentially simple licensing resale, but profitability and eligibility depend on an authorized channel and supplier pricing. Keep as reseller investigation, not a direct GREEN.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Belgium – Oracle licensing/support procurement for SPW
confirmed_supergreens.why: Large licensing opportunity but entirely dependent on Oracle channel eligibility and economics. Keep as a commercial partner play rather than a software-delivery GREEN.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Poland – software support / maintenance requirement
confirmed_supergreens.why: Potential reseller/support lane, but authorization and local service requirements remain decisive. No direct SPM capability should be inferred.

confirmed_supergreens.title: BPA - Pipe, Hose & Tubing PSC 4710, 4720, 4730
unknowns: Authoritative current submission timing is not resolved from the recovered DCE.
SPM has not evidenced relevant federal past performance or a compliant pipe/hose/tubing supplier route.
Domestic-content/origin and other federal supply clauses require item-level supplier validation.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Not a native SPM service, but unlike the other hot items it is potentially brokerable commodity supply. Keep only as a supplier/middleman investigation, not as a GREEN bid.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Defense Logistics Information Research (DLIR)
blockers: Retrieved authoritative material repeatedly states a 2021 BAA closing date while the live notice metadata says 2026-09-01; current submission authority is not reconciled.
The BAA is defense logistics R&D with technical/scientific review, detailed cost realism, DCAA/accounting representations and research-team expectations rather than a lean SPM service procurement.
Relevant prior research, technical papers, key personnel and detailed cost structure are integral to evaluation.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Interesting AI/RPA language produced a semantic false positive, but the current DCE evidence is both temporally conflicted and qualification-heavy defense R&D.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Iziko Museums display infrastructure fabrication and installation
blockers: Physical fabrication/installation scope
confirmed_supergreens.why: False positive: DCE is fabrication and installation of exhibition display infrastructure in Cape Town rather than graphic design alone.

confirmed_supergreens.title: SENT/022/2026-27
blockers: Scope mismatch: lighting project
Reference-heavy local delivery
confirmed_supergreens.why: False positive: DCE concerns a lighting project and scores prior related lighting projects via reference letters/completion certificates. It is not website development.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Predictive Lake Analytics Nextgen eXchange Services (PLANXS)
blockers: Non-competitive extension / incumbent-specific action
confirmed_supergreens.why: DCE is a justification for exception to fair opportunity / non-competitive extension of the current PLANXS award, not an open new SPM opportunity.

confirmed_supergreens.title: ULTRA-BROADBAND TERAHERTZ RADIO DEVELOPMENT
blockers: Advanced terahertz radio hardware/R&D program is not a lean SPM delivery scope.
DCE states the BAA is closed to foreign participation except limited fundamental-research exceptions and contains foreign-national/FOCI controls.
Security-risk review, senior/key-person disclosures and scientific/technical capability are material requirements.
confirmed_supergreens.why: A live open BAA, but fundamentally the wrong bidder and technical profile for SPM.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Physical Security Services, Coos Bay District BLM
blockers: Physical guard/security-service scope
Licensing and local workforce requirements
confirmed_supergreens.why: False semantic fit. This is a physical security-services procurement, not a software-development opportunity suitable for lean SPM execution.

confirmed_supergreens.title: One Acquisition Solution for Integrated Services Plus (OASIS+) Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) Set-Aside Continuously Open Solicitation
blockers: This vehicle is explicitly an SDVOSB set-aside and requires qualification under that program for prime award.
The DCE contains extensive scored qualification, cybersecurity/supply-chain, reporting and contract-vehicle requirements well beyond a lean one-off SPM tender.
unknowns: No evidence in the tender-engine bidder profile establishes SPM as an eligible SDVOSB prime.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Potentially broad services, but the mandatory socioeconomic vehicle gate and heavy IDIQ qualification make it non-actionable for SPM on current evidence.

confirmed_supergreens.title: R--Region 6 Superfund Technical Assessment and Response Team (START) IV
blockers: The recovered DCE is a bridge justification for other than full and open competition covering July 2023-January 2024, not a current open competitive solicitation.
Mission scope is EPA Superfund emergency technical assessment/response, not SPM's lean digital/creative/broker core.
confirmed_supergreens.why: The hot queue treated substantive historical acquisition paperwork as live bid evidence.

confirmed_supergreens.title: France – Co-commissariat aux comptes France Travail
blockers: Regulated statutory-audit mandate
Professional qualification requirement outside SPM model
confirmed_supergreens.why: This is a regulated statutory audit mandate, not a generic IT/services opportunity. The semantic IT-services hit is not commercially relevant for SPM.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Malta – medical X-ray equipment procurement
blockers: Specialized regulated medical-equipment scope
confirmed_supergreens.why: Physical regulated medical-equipment supply with specialist compliance requirements. Not a realistic SPM lean/broker target from current evidence.

confirmed_supergreens.title: R/V Caretta Shipyard Repairs
blockers: Shipyard physical repair scope
confirmed_supergreens.why: False positive: authoritative DCE is shipyard repair work, not a web-portal project.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Patient lifts and Installation
blockers: DCE is an only-one-responsible-source restricted-competition justification for Guldmann patient-lift equipment and installation.
Scope requires medical patient-lift hardware, structural installation/load testing and safe-patient-handling compliance, not SPM's lean core.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Medical equipment installation plus restricted-source procurement; not realistically executable by SPM as prime.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Jamaica Strategic Public Sector Transformation
blockers: Recovered material is broad project/procurement-plan context for a World Bank-financed public-sector transformation program, not a specific currently actionable solicitation with a submission deadline.
No specific SPM-fit deliverable, bidder gate set or submission package is established in the evidence.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Project-level procurement context was incorrectly promoted as a bid-ready tender.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Vendor Collaboration - MULTI-CENTER CLINICAL TRIALS OF NOVEL THERAPIES FOR PATIENTS WITH WELL CHARACTERIZED GASTROPARESIS
blockers: The DCE explicitly says this is not a procurement contract or grant for goods/services and that NIDDK provides no funds to selected collaborators.
It seeks clinical-research collaborators contributing therapeutic agents, devices, laboratory capability and research funding/resources.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Not a revenue tender at all; it is a clinical research collaboration opportunity.

confirmed_supergreens.title: J065--Zeiss Microscope Maintenance - NWI
blockers: Authoritative justification says maintenance must be performed by Zeiss-certified field engineers and identifies PROAIM as the only authorized Zeiss representative accepted for service/repair labor.
Recovered award material names PROAIM AMERICAS, LLC as awardee on 2026-08-14.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Already-awarded/single-source manufacturer-authorized maintenance, not a live SPM opportunity.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Explosive Trace Detection (ETD) Qualified Products List (QPL)
blockers: Applicant must provide production-representative explosive-trace-detection systems meeting TSA detection/functional standards and pass certification/qualification testing.
DCE contains classified/SSI handling, facility/personnel clearance and DD Form 254 requirements where applicable.
This is specialized security-screening hardware qualification, not an SPM service or brokerable generic supply tender.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Hard technical/security qualification makes this an obvious false positive.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Ireland – Computer support services – ICT services for the Operation and Maintenance of the Waters of LIFE Web Portal and Smart Phone Application
confirmed_supergreens.buyer: Department of Housing Local Government and Heritage
unknowns: SPM must confirm that its current insurance arrangements can meet the exact policy levels required by paragraph 2.21.1 or arrange compliant cover if awarded.

SPM must evidence a credible delivery team for the existing Go backend, web management dashboard and Flutter mobile application across the contract term; subcontracting/consortium is expressly available if specialist capacity is needed.
SPM must provide acceptable Irish tax-clearance evidence prior to award.
The existing system takeover and ongoing security/support obligations should be technically scoped before pricing to avoid underestimating maintenance effort.
confirmed_supergreens.why: This is a live, authoritative and unusually strong SPM-fit ICT maintenance opportunity. The DCE resolves the true tender deadline to 18 September 2026 at 17:00, while 11 September is only the query deadline. The contract is capped at EUR 80k, the turnover selection criterion is explicitly N/A, no numeric minimum prior-reference or named-certification threshold was identified, and consortium/subcontracting is permitted. The work directly covers a Go backend, web dashboard and Flutter mobile app with maintenance, security, bug-fixing, compatibility and testing. Bidder-specific insurance, tax and delivery-capacity evidence prevent FINAL_SUPER_GREEN but do not constitute an established hard blocker to GREEN.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Provision of a Single Party Framework for the ongoing support, maintenance, and development of YourSpace Portals, associated websites, associated systems and associated services.
unknowns: Whether SPM alone meets EUR 100k turnover in each of the last three financial years
Whether SPM/partners can evidence three comparable contracts at the required scale
Whether required insurance levels or broker confirmations can be arranged
Whether two EU/EEA hosting facilities and required resources can be demonstrated
confirmed_supergreens.why: Excellent digital scope but the qualification burden is material. Viable as partner/consortium/reliance route if turnover, three comparable references, hosting and insurance gates can be covered; not a solo supergreen on current evidence.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Germany – IT services: consulting, software development, Internet and support – Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung Websites

unknowns: Whether SPM/partners have three sufficiently strong Magnolia CMS references
Whether required ISMS/security capability and operational staffing can be demonstrated
Whether insurance requirements can be met
confirmed_supergreens.why: Strategically relevant web work but operationally enterprise-heavy and reference-driven. Three detailed Magnolia references determine selection into the top five; substantial cloud/security/operations burden makes this partner-heavy rather than lean-direct.

confirmed_supergreens.title: BPA - Pipe, Hose & Tubing PSC 4710, 4720, 4730
unknowns: Authoritative current submission timing is not resolved from the recovered DCE.
SPM has not evidenced relevant federal past performance or a compliant pipe/hose/tubing supplier route.
Domestic-content/origin and other federal supply clauses require item-level supplier validation.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Not a native SPM service, but unlike the other hot items it is potentially brokerable commodity supply. Keep only as a supplier/middleman investigation, not as a GREEN bid.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Defense Logistics Information Research (DLIR)
blockers: Retrieved authoritative material repeatedly states a 2021 BAA closing date while the live notice metadata says 2026-09-01; current submission authority is not reconciled.
The BAA is defense logistics R&D with technical/scientific review, detailed cost realism, DCAA/accounting representations and research-team expectations rather than a lean SPM service procurement.
Relevant prior research, technical papers, key personnel and detailed cost structure are integral to evaluation.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Interesting AI/RPA language produced a semantic false positive, but the current DCE evidence is both temporally conflicted and qualification-heavy defense R&D.

confirmed_supergreens.title: ULTRA-BROADBAND TERAHERTZ RADIO DEVELOPMENT
blockers: Advanced terahertz radio hardware/R&D program is not a lean SPM delivery scope.
DCE states the BAA is closed to foreign participation except limited fundamental-research exceptions and contains foreign-national/FOCI controls.
Security-risk review, senior/key-person disclosures and scientific/technical capability are material requirements.
confirmed_supergreens.why: A live open BAA, but fundamentally the wrong bidder and technical profile for SPM.

confirmed_supergreens.title: One Acquisition Solution for Integrated Services Plus (OASIS+) Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) Set-Aside Continuously Open Solicitation
blockers: This vehicle is explicitly an SDVOSB set-aside and requires qualification under that program for prime award.
The DCE contains extensive scored qualification, cybersecurity/supply-chain, reporting and contract-vehicle requirements well beyond a lean one-off SPM tender.
unknowns: No evidence in the tender-engine bidder profile establishes SPM as an eligible SDVOSB prime.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Potentially broad services, but the mandatory socioeconomic vehicle gate and heavy IDIQ qualification make it non-actionable for SPM on current evidence.

confirmed_supergreens.title: R--Region 6 Superfund Technical Assessment and Response Team (START) IV
blockers: The recovered DCE is a bridge justification for other than full and open competition covering July 2023-January 2024, not a current open competitive solicitation.
Mission scope is EPA Superfund emergency technical assessment/response, not SPM's lean digital/creative/broker core.
confirmed_supergreens.why: The hot queue treated substantive historical acquisition paperwork as live bid evidence.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Patient lifts and Installation
blockers: DCE is an only-one-responsible-source restricted-competition justification for Guldmann patient-lift equipment and installation.
Scope requires medical patient-lift hardware, structural installation/load testing and safe-patient-handling compliance, not SPM's lean core.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Medical equipment installation plus restricted-source procurement; not realistically executable by SPM as prime.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Jamaica Strategic Public Sector Transformation
blockers: Recovered material is broad project/procurement-plan context for a World Bank-financed public-sector transformation program, not a specific currently actionable solicitation with a submission deadline.
No specific SPM-fit deliverable, bidder gate set or submission package is established in the evidence.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Project-level procurement context was incorrectly promoted as a bid-ready tender.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Vendor Collaboration - MULTI-CENTER CLINICAL TRIALS OF NOVEL THERAPIES FOR PATIENTS WITH WELL CHARACTERIZED GASTROPARESIS
blockers: The DCE explicitly says this is not a procurement contract or grant for goods/services and that NIDDK provides no funds to selected collaborators.
It seeks clinical-research collaborators contributing therapeutic agents, devices, laboratory capability and research funding/resources.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Not a revenue tender at all; it is a clinical research collaboration opportunity.

confirmed_supergreens.title: J065--Zeiss Microscope Maintenance - NWI
blockers: Authoritative justification says maintenance must be performed by Zeiss-certified field engineers and identifies PROAIM as the only authorized Zeiss representative accepted for service/repair labor.
Recovered award material names PROAIM AMERICAS, LLC as awardee on 2026-08-14.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Already-awarded/single-source manufacturer-authorized maintenance, not a live SPM opportunity.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Explosive Trace Detection (ETD) Qualified Products List (QPL)
blockers: Applicant must provide production-representative explosive-trace-detection systems meeting TSA detection/functional standards and pass certification/qualification testing.
DCE contains classified/SSI handling, facility/personnel clearance and DD Form 254 requirements where applicable.
This is specialized security-screening hardware qualification, not an SPM service or brokerable generic supply tender.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Hard technical/security qualification makes this an obvious false positive.

award_criteria.text: Seite 2 von 7 1 Einleitung 1.1 Angaben zur ILB Die Investitionsbank des Landes Brandenburg (ILB) wurde 1992 als Kreditinstitut in der Rechtsform einer rechtsfähigen Anstalt des öffentlichen Rechts mit Sitz in Potsdam gegründet. Die ILB bildet zusammen mit ihren sechs Tochterunternehmen den ILB-Konzern. Die Geschäftsentwicklung ist unverändert maßgeblich von der ILB geprägt. Als Förderbank für Brandenburg unterstützt die ILB das Land bei der Umsetzung seiner struktur- und wirtschaftspolitischen Ziele in den Bereichen Wirtschaft, Arbeit, Infrastruktur und Wohnungsbau. Darüber hinaus übernimmt die Bank die Verwaltung und Verwertung von Treuhandvermögen sowie die Bildung und Verwaltung von Sondervermögen. Die ILB betreibt nur Geschäfte, die der Umsetzung des gesetzlichen Förderauftrages dienen. Die zur Durchführung der Aufgaben benötigten Mittel refinanziert die Bank im Wesentlichen bei der Europäischen Investitionsbank (EIB), der Landwirtschaftlichen Rentenbank (LR), der KfW Bankengruppe (KfW), der Council of Europe Development Bank (CEB) sowie durch die Ausgabe von eigenen Schuldverschreibungen. Die Bank ist Partner der Förderinstitute des Bundes und der Europäischen Union. Die ILB gehört unter anderem dem Bundesverband Öffentlicher Banken Deutschlands (VÖB)
