confirmed_supergreens.buyer: Department of Housing Local Government and Heritage
unknowns: SPM must confirm that its current insurance arrangements can meet the exact policy levels required by paragraph 2.21.1 or arrange compliant cover if awarded.

SPM must evidence a credible delivery team for the existing Go backend, web management dashboard and Flutter mobile application across the contract term; subcontracting/consortium is expressly available if specialist capacity is needed.
SPM must provide acceptable Irish tax-clearance evidence prior to award.
The existing system takeover and ongoing security/support obligations should be technically scoped before pricing to avoid underestimating maintenance effort.
confirmed_supergreens.why: This is a live, authoritative and unusually strong SPM-fit ICT maintenance opportunity. The DCE resolves the true tender deadline to 18 September 2026 at 17:00, while 11 September is only the query deadline. The contract is capped at EUR 80k, the turnover selection criterion is explicitly N/A, no numeric minimum prior-reference or named-certification threshold was identified, and consortium/subcontracting is permitted. The work directly covers a Go backend, web dashboard and Flutter mobile app with maintenance, security, bug-fixing, compatibility and testing. Bidder-specific insurance, tax and delivery-capacity evidence prevent FINAL_SUPER_GREEN but do not constitute an established hard blocker to GREEN.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Provision of a Single Party Framework for the ongoing support, maintenance, and development of YourSpace Portals, associated websites, associated systems and associated services.
unknowns: Whether SPM alone meets EUR 100k turnover in each of the last three financial years
Whether SPM/partners can evidence three comparable contracts at the required scale
Whether required insurance levels or broker confirmations can be arranged
Whether two EU/EEA hosting facilities and required resources can be demonstrated
confirmed_supergreens.why: Excellent digital scope but the qualification burden is material. Viable as partner/consortium/reliance route if turnover, three comparable references, hosting and insurance gates can be covered; not a solo supergreen on current evidence.

unknowns: Whether SPM/partners have three sufficiently strong Magnolia CMS references

Whether insurance requirements can be met
confirmed_supergreens.why: Strategically relevant web work but operationally enterprise-heavy and reference-driven. Three detailed Magnolia references determine selection into the top five; substantial cloud/security/operations burden makes this partner-heavy rather than lean-direct.

confirmed_supergreens.title: BPA - Pipe, Hose & Tubing PSC 4710, 4720, 4730
unknowns: Authoritative current submission timing is not resolved from the recovered DCE.

Domestic-content/origin and other federal supply clauses require item-level supplier validation.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Not a native SPM service, but unlike the other hot items it is potentially brokerable commodity supply. Keep only as a supplier/middleman investigation, not as a GREEN bid.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Defense Logistics Information Research (DLIR)
blockers: Retrieved authoritative material repeatedly states a 2021 BAA closing date while the live notice metadata says 2026-09-01; current submission authority is not reconciled.
The BAA is defense logistics R&D with technical/scientific review, detailed cost realism, DCAA/accounting representations and research-team expectations rather than a lean SPM service procurement.
Relevant prior research, technical papers, key personnel and detailed cost structure are integral to evaluation.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Interesting AI/RPA language produced a semantic false positive, but the current DCE evidence is both temporally conflicted and qualification-heavy defense R&D.

confirmed_supergreens.title: ULTRA-BROADBAND TERAHERTZ RADIO DEVELOPMENT
blockers: Advanced terahertz radio hardware/R&D program is not a lean SPM delivery scope.
DCE states the BAA is closed to foreign participation except limited fundamental-research exceptions and contains foreign-national/FOCI controls.
Security-risk review, senior/key-person disclosures and scientific/technical capability are material requirements.
confirmed_supergreens.why: A live open BAA, but fundamentally the wrong bidder and technical profile for SPM.

confirmed_supergreens.title: One Acquisition Solution for Integrated Services Plus (OASIS+) Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) Set-Aside Continuously Open Solicitation
blockers: This vehicle is explicitly an SDVOSB set-aside and requires qualification under that program for prime award.
The DCE contains extensive scored qualification, cybersecurity/supply-chain, reporting and contract-vehicle requirements well beyond a lean one-off SPM tender.
unknowns: No evidence in the tender-engine bidder profile establishes SPM as an eligible SDVOSB prime.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Potentially broad services, but the mandatory socioeconomic vehicle gate and heavy IDIQ qualification make it non-actionable for SPM on current evidence.

confirmed_supergreens.title: R--Region 6 Superfund Technical Assessment and Response Team (START) IV
blockers: The recovered DCE is a bridge justification for other than full and open competition covering July 2023-January 2024, not a current open competitive solicitation.
Mission scope is EPA Superfund emergency technical assessment/response, not SPM's lean digital/creative/broker core.
confirmed_supergreens.why: The hot queue treated substantive historical acquisition paperwork as live bid evidence.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Patient lifts and Installation
blockers: DCE is an only-one-responsible-source restricted-competition justification for Guldmann patient-lift equipment and installation.
Scope requires medical patient-lift hardware, structural installation/load testing and safe-patient-handling compliance, not SPM's lean core.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Medical equipment installation plus restricted-source procurement; not realistically executable by SPM as prime.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Jamaica Strategic Public Sector Transformation
blockers: Recovered material is broad project/procurement-plan context for a World Bank-financed public-sector transformation program, not a specific currently actionable solicitation with a submission deadline.
No specific SPM-fit deliverable, bidder gate set or submission package is established in the evidence.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Project-level procurement context was incorrectly promoted as a bid-ready tender.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Vendor Collaboration - MULTI-CENTER CLINICAL TRIALS OF NOVEL THERAPIES FOR PATIENTS WITH WELL CHARACTERIZED GASTROPARESIS
blockers: The DCE explicitly says this is not a procurement contract or grant for goods/services and that NIDDK provides no funds to selected collaborators.
It seeks clinical-research collaborators contributing therapeutic agents, devices, laboratory capability and research funding/resources.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Not a revenue tender at all; it is a clinical research collaboration opportunity.

confirmed_supergreens.title: J065--Zeiss Microscope Maintenance - NWI
blockers: Authoritative justification says maintenance must be performed by Zeiss-certified field engineers and identifies PROAIM as the only authorized Zeiss representative accepted for service/repair labor.
Recovered award material names PROAIM AMERICAS, LLC as awardee on 2026-08-14.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Already-awarded/single-source manufacturer-authorized maintenance, not a live SPM opportunity.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Explosive Trace Detection (ETD) Qualified Products List (QPL)
blockers: Applicant must provide production-representative explosive-trace-detection systems meeting TSA detection/functional standards and pass certification/qualification testing.
DCE contains classified/SSI handling, facility/personnel clearance and DD Form 254 requirements where applicable.
This is specialized security-screening hardware qualification, not an SPM service or brokerable generic supply tender.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Hard technical/security qualification makes this an obvious false positive.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Ireland – Computer support services – ICT services for the Operation and Maintenance of the Waters of LIFE Web Portal and Smart Phone Application
confirmed_supergreens.buyer: Department of Housing Local Government and Heritage
unknowns: SPM must confirm that its current insurance arrangements can meet the exact policy levels required by paragraph 2.21.1 or arrange compliant cover if awarded.

SPM must evidence a credible delivery team for the existing Go backend, web management dashboard and Flutter mobile application across the contract term; subcontracting/consortium is expressly available if specialist capacity is needed.
SPM must provide acceptable Irish tax-clearance evidence prior to award.
The existing system takeover and ongoing security/support obligations should be technically scoped before pricing to avoid underestimating maintenance effort.
confirmed_supergreens.why: This is a live, authoritative and unusually strong SPM-fit ICT maintenance opportunity. The DCE resolves the true tender deadline to 18 September 2026 at 17:00, while 11 September is only the query deadline. The contract is capped at EUR 80k, the turnover selection criterion is explicitly N/A, no numeric minimum prior-reference or named-certification threshold was identified, and consortium/subcontracting is permitted. The work directly covers a Go backend, web dashboard and Flutter mobile app with maintenance, security, bug-fixing, compatibility and testing. Bidder-specific insurance, tax and delivery-capacity evidence prevent FINAL_SUPER_GREEN but do not constitute an established hard blocker to GREEN.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Provision of a Single Party Framework for the ongoing support, maintenance, and development of YourSpace Portals, associated websites, associated systems and associated services.
unknowns: Whether SPM alone meets EUR 100k turnover in each of the last three financial years
Whether SPM/partners can evidence three comparable contracts at the required scale
Whether required insurance levels or broker confirmations can be arranged
Whether two EU/EEA hosting facilities and required resources can be demonstrated
confirmed_supergreens.why: Excellent digital scope but the qualification burden is material. Viable as partner/consortium/reliance route if turnover, three comparable references, hosting and insurance gates can be covered; not a solo supergreen on current evidence.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Germany – IT services: consulting, software development, Internet and support – Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung Websites
confirmed_supergreens.buyer: Kulturveranstaltungen des Bundes in Berlin GmbH (KBB GmbH)
unknowns: Whether SPM/partners have three sufficiently strong Magnolia CMS references
Whether required ISMS/security capability and operational staffing can be demonstrated
Whether insurance requirements can be met
confirmed_supergreens.why: Strategically relevant web work but operationally enterprise-heavy and reference-driven. Three detailed Magnolia references determine selection into the top five; substantial cloud/security/operations burden makes this partner-heavy rather than lean-direct.

confirmed_supergreens.title: BPA - Pipe, Hose & Tubing PSC 4710, 4720, 4730
unknowns: Authoritative current submission timing is not resolved from the recovered DCE.
SPM has not evidenced relevant federal past performance or a compliant pipe/hose/tubing supplier route.
Domestic-content/origin and other federal supply clauses require item-level supplier validation.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Not a native SPM service, but unlike the other hot items it is potentially brokerable commodity supply. Keep only as a supplier/middleman investigation, not as a GREEN bid.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Defense Logistics Information Research (DLIR)
blockers: Retrieved authoritative material repeatedly states a 2021 BAA closing date while the live notice metadata says 2026-09-01; current submission authority is not reconciled.
The BAA is defense logistics R&D with technical/scientific review, detailed cost realism, DCAA/accounting representations and research-team expectations rather than a lean SPM service procurement.
Relevant prior research, technical papers, key personnel and detailed cost structure are integral to evaluation.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Interesting AI/RPA language produced a semantic false positive, but the current DCE evidence is both temporally conflicted and qualification-heavy defense R&D.

confirmed_supergreens.title: ULTRA-BROADBAND TERAHERTZ RADIO DEVELOPMENT
blockers: Advanced terahertz radio hardware/R&D program is not a lean SPM delivery scope.
DCE states the BAA is closed to foreign participation except limited fundamental-research exceptions and contains foreign-national/FOCI controls.
Security-risk review, senior/key-person disclosures and scientific/technical capability are material requirements.
confirmed_supergreens.why: A live open BAA, but fundamentally the wrong bidder and technical profile for SPM.

confirmed_supergreens.title: One Acquisition Solution for Integrated Services Plus (OASIS+) Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) Set-Aside Continuously Open Solicitation
blockers: This vehicle is explicitly an SDVOSB set-aside and requires qualification under that program for prime award.
The DCE contains extensive scored qualification, cybersecurity/supply-chain, reporting and contract-vehicle requirements well beyond a lean one-off SPM tender.
unknowns: No evidence in the tender-engine bidder profile establishes SPM as an eligible SDVOSB prime.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Potentially broad services, but the mandatory socioeconomic vehicle gate and heavy IDIQ qualification make it non-actionable for SPM on current evidence.

confirmed_supergreens.title: R--Region 6 Superfund Technical Assessment and Response Team (START) IV
blockers: The recovered DCE is a bridge justification for other than full and open competition covering July 2023-January 2024, not a current open competitive solicitation.
Mission scope is EPA Superfund emergency technical assessment/response, not SPM's lean digital/creative/broker core.
confirmed_supergreens.why: The hot queue treated substantive historical acquisition paperwork as live bid evidence.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Patient lifts and Installation
blockers: DCE is an only-one-responsible-source restricted-competition justification for Guldmann patient-lift equipment and installation.
Scope requires medical patient-lift hardware, structural installation/load testing and safe-patient-handling compliance, not SPM's lean core.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Medical equipment installation plus restricted-source procurement; not realistically executable by SPM as prime.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Jamaica Strategic Public Sector Transformation
blockers: Recovered material is broad project/procurement-plan context for a World Bank-financed public-sector transformation program, not a specific currently actionable solicitation with a submission deadline.
No specific SPM-fit deliverable, bidder gate set or submission package is established in the evidence.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Project-level procurement context was incorrectly promoted as a bid-ready tender.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Vendor Collaboration - MULTI-CENTER CLINICAL TRIALS OF NOVEL THERAPIES FOR PATIENTS WITH WELL CHARACTERIZED GASTROPARESIS
blockers: The DCE explicitly says this is not a procurement contract or grant for goods/services and that NIDDK provides no funds to selected collaborators.
It seeks clinical-research collaborators contributing therapeutic agents, devices, laboratory capability and research funding/resources.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Not a revenue tender at all; it is a clinical research collaboration opportunity.

confirmed_supergreens.title: J065--Zeiss Microscope Maintenance - NWI
blockers: Authoritative justification says maintenance must be performed by Zeiss-certified field engineers and identifies PROAIM as the only authorized Zeiss representative accepted for service/repair labor.
Recovered award material names PROAIM AMERICAS, LLC as awardee on 2026-08-14.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Already-awarded/single-source manufacturer-authorized maintenance, not a live SPM opportunity.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Explosive Trace Detection (ETD) Qualified Products List (QPL)
blockers: Applicant must provide production-representative explosive-trace-detection systems meeting TSA detection/functional standards and pass certification/qualification testing.
DCE contains classified/SSI handling, facility/personnel clearance and DD Form 254 requirements where applicable.
This is specialized security-screening hardware qualification, not an SPM service or brokerable generic supply tender.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Hard technical/security qualification makes this an obvious false positive.

April 2022 nicht an Personen oder Unternehmen vergeben werden, die einen Bezug zu Russland im Sinne der Vor- schrift aufweisen. Dies umfasst sowohl unmittelbar als Bewerber, Bieter oder Auftragnehmer auftretende Per- sonen oder Unternehmen als auch mittelbar, mit mehr als zehn Prozent, gemessen am Auftragswert, beteiligte Unterauftragnehmer, Lieferanten oder Eignungsverleiher. Ein Bezug zu Russland im Sinne der Vorschrift besteht a) durch die russische Staatsangehörigkeit des Bewerbers/Bieters oder die Niederlassung des Be- werbers/Bieters in Russland, b) durch die Beteiligung einer natürlichen Person oder eines Unternehmens, auf die eines der Kriteri en nach Buchstabe a zutrifft, am Bewerber/Bieter über das Halten von Anteilen im Umfang von mehr als 50 Prozent, c) durch das Handeln der Bewerber/Bieter im Namen oder auf Anweisung von Personen oder Unter- nehmen, auf die die Kriterien der Buchstaben a) und/oder b) zutreffen. Bereits vor dem 9. April 2022 geschlossene Verträge mit solchen Personen oder Unternehmen mit Bezug zu Russland dürfen nur bis zum 10. Oktober 2022 fortgeführt werden. aggeber Auftraggeber (AG) für die ausgeschriebene Leistung ist: Bischöfliches Generalvikariat Domhof 18-21 31134 Hildesheim Das Bistum Hildesheim betreibt als Schulträger an der St.-Augustinus-Schule in Hildesheim (ca. 46 Lehrkräfte, ca. 380 SuS) eine IT-Infrastruktur, über die der Schule eine Vielzahl an IT-Diensten bereitgestellt wird. Dazu zählen u. a. der Internet-Zugang, Server- und Speicher-Leistungen, zentrale Anwendungen, E-Mail-Dienste sowie Hard- und Software-Support. Die Schule verfügt an einem Standort über ein pädagogisches Netz und ein Schulverwaltungsnetz, die logisch getrennt betrieben werden. Die IT-Unterstützung erfolgt bislang fragmentiert über schulische Einzelregelungen: Für das Netzwerk ist ein externer Dienstleister beauftragt, für die iPads und das Mobile Device Management (MDM) ein weiterer – jeweils ohne klar definierte Service-Level-Agreements (SLAs) und ohne einheitliche Supportprozesse. Alle üb-rigen Themen – insbesondere Endgeräte und Medientechnik, der 1st-Level-Support für die Anwenderinnen und Anwender sowie die Koordination der beteiligten Dienstleister – liegen bislang bei der Schule selbst und werden im Wesentlichen durch die IT-Beauftragten neben ihrer Unterrichtstätigkeit geleistet. Mit der vorlie-genden Ausschreibung soll diese Betreuung vere

confirmed_supergreens.title: Provision of a Single Party Framework for the ongoing support, maintenance, and development of YourSpace Portals, associated websites, associated systems and associated services.
unknowns: Whether SPM alone meets EUR 100k turnover in each of the last three financial years
Whether SPM/partners can evidence three comparable contracts at the required scale

confirmed_supergreens.title: Germany – IT services: consulting, software development, Internet and support – Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung Websites
confirmed_supergreens.buyer: Kulturveranstaltungen des Bundes in Berlin GmbH (KBB GmbH)
unknowns: Whether SPM/partners have three sufficiently strong Magnolia CMS references
Whether required ISMS/security capability and operational staffing can be demonstrated
Whether insurance requirements can be met

confirmed_supergreens.title: BPA - Pipe, Hose & Tubing PSC 4710, 4720, 4730
unknowns: Authoritative current submission timing is not resolved from the recovered DCE.
SPM has not evidenced relevant federal past performance or a compliant pipe/hose/tubing supplier route.
Domestic-content/origin and other federal supply clauses require item-level supplier validation.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Not a native SPM service, but unlike the other hot items it is potentially brokerable commodity supply. Keep only as a supplier/middleman investigation, not as a GREEN bid.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Defense Logistics Information Research (DLIR)
blockers: Retrieved authoritative material repeatedly states a 2021 BAA closing date while the live notice metadata says 2026-09-01; current submission authority is not reconciled.
The BAA is defense logistics R&D with technical/scientific review, detailed cost realism, DCAA/accounting representations and research-team expectations rather than a lean SPM service procurement.
Relevant prior research, technical papers, key personnel and detailed cost structure are integral to evaluation.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Interesting AI/RPA language produced a semantic false positive, but the current DCE evidence is both temporally conflicted and qualification-heavy defense R&D.

confirmed_supergreens.title: ULTRA-BROADBAND TERAHERTZ RADIO DEVELOPMENT
blockers: Advanced terahertz radio hardware/R&D program is not a lean SPM delivery scope.
DCE states the BAA is closed to foreign participation except limited fundamental-research exceptions and contains foreign-national/FOCI controls.
Security-risk review, senior/key-person disclosures and scientific/technical capability are material requirements.
confirmed_supergreens.why: A live open BAA, but fundamentally the wrong bidder and technical profile for SPM.

confirmed_supergreens.title: One Acquisition Solution for Integrated Services Plus (OASIS+) Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) Set-Aside Continuously Open Solicitation
blockers: This vehicle is explicitly an SDVOSB set-aside and requires qualification under that program for prime award.
The DCE contains extensive scored qualification, cybersecurity/supply-chain, reporting and contract-vehicle requirements well beyond a lean one-off SPM tender.
unknowns: No evidence in the tender-engine bidder profile establishes SPM as an eligible SDVOSB prime.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Potentially broad services, but the mandatory socioeconomic vehicle gate and heavy IDIQ qualification make it non-actionable for SPM on current evidence.

confirmed_supergreens.title: R--Region 6 Superfund Technical Assessment and Response Team (START) IV
blockers: The recovered DCE is a bridge justification for other than full and open competition covering July 2023-January 2024, not a current open competitive solicitation.
Mission scope is EPA Superfund emergency technical assessment/response, not SPM's lean digital/creative/broker core.
confirmed_supergreens.why: The hot queue treated substantive historical acquisition paperwork as live bid evidence.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Patient lifts and Installation
blockers: DCE is an only-one-responsible-source restricted-competition justification for Guldmann patient-lift equipment and installation.
Scope requires medical patient-lift hardware, structural installation/load testing and safe-patient-handling compliance, not SPM's lean core.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Medical equipment installation plus restricted-source procurement; not realistically executable by SPM as prime.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Jamaica Strategic Public Sector Transformation
blockers: Recovered material is broad project/procurement-plan context for a World Bank-financed public-sector transformation program, not a specific currently actionable solicitation with a submission deadline.
No specific SPM-fit deliverable, bidder gate set or submission package is established in the evidence.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Project-level procurement context was incorrectly promoted as a bid-ready tender.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Vendor Collaboration - MULTI-CENTER CLINICAL TRIALS OF NOVEL THERAPIES FOR PATIENTS WITH WELL CHARACTERIZED GASTROPARESIS
blockers: The DCE explicitly says this is not a procurement contract or grant for goods/services and that NIDDK provides no funds to selected collaborators.
It seeks clinical-research collaborators contributing therapeutic agents, devices, laboratory capability and research funding/resources.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Not a revenue tender at all; it is a clinical research collaboration opportunity.

confirmed_supergreens.title: J065--Zeiss Microscope Maintenance - NWI
blockers: Authoritative justification says maintenance must be performed by Zeiss-certified field engineers and identifies PROAIM as the only authorized Zeiss representative accepted for service/repair labor.
Recovered award material names PROAIM AMERICAS, LLC as awardee on 2026-08-14.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Already-awarded/single-source manufacturer-authorized maintenance, not a live SPM opportunity.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Explosive Trace Detection (ETD) Qualified Products List (QPL)
blockers: Applicant must provide production-representative explosive-trace-detection systems meeting TSA detection/functional standards and pass certification/qualification testing.
DCE contains classified/SSI handling, facility/personnel clearance and DD Form 254 requirements where applicable.
This is specialized security-screening hardware qualification, not an SPM service or brokerable generic supply tender.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Hard technical/security qualification makes this an obvious false positive.

Projekträume Für jedes BIM-Projekt ist ein separater Projektraum innerhalb der CDE mit einer vom Auftraggeber vorgegebenen Datenstruktur einzurichten. Jeder Projektraum ist über eine unbestimmte Laufzeit innerhalb der Vertragslaufzeit vorzuhalten. Nach Abruf zur Einrichtung eines Projektraumes muss spätestens nach 7 Werktagen ein Kick-Off-Gespräch stattfinden, in dem u.a. Workflows und die Datenstruktur abgestimmt werden. Die Bereitstellung des Projektraumes inkl. aller Funktionen muss wiederum spätestens 2 Wochen nach dem Kick Off-Gespräch erfolgen. Sofern die Workflowkonfigurationen und ggf. confirmed_supergreens.why: Strategically relevant web work but operationally enterprise-heavy and reference-driven. Three detailed Magnolia references determine selection into the top five; substantial cloud/security/operations burden makes this partner-heavy rather than lean-direct.

confirmed_supergreens.title: BPA - Pipe, Hose & Tubing PSC 4710, 4720, 4730
unknowns: Authoritative current submission timing is not resolved from the recovered DCE.
SPM has not evidenced relevant federal past performance or a compliant pipe/hose/tubing supplier route.
Domestic-content/origin and other federal supply clauses require item-level supplier validation.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Not a native SPM service, but unlike the other hot items it is potentially brokerable commodity supply. Keep only as a supplier/middleman investigation, not as a GREEN bid.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Defense Logistics Information Research (DLIR)
blockers: Retrieved authoritative material repeatedly states a 2021 BAA closing date while the live notice metadata says 2026-09-01; current submission authority is not reconciled.
The BAA is defense logistics R&D with technical/scientific review, detailed cost realism, DCAA/accounting representations and research-team expectations rather than a lean SPM service procurement.
Relevant prior research, technical papers, key personnel and detailed cost structure are integral to evaluation.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Interesting AI/RPA language produced a semantic false positive, but the current DCE evidence is both temporally conflicted and qualification-heavy defense R&D.

confirmed_supergreens.title: ULTRA-BROADBAND TERAHERTZ RADIO DEVELOPMENT
blockers: Advanced terahertz radio hardware/R&D program is not a lean SPM delivery scope.
DCE states the BAA is closed to foreign participation except limited fundamental-research exceptions and contains foreign-national/FOCI controls.
Security-risk review, senior/key-person disclosures and scientific/technical capability are material requirements.
confirmed_supergreens.why: A live open BAA, but fundamentally the wrong bidder and technical profile for SPM.

confirmed_supergreens.title: One Acquisition Solution for Integrated Services Plus (OASIS+) Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) Set-Aside Continuously Open Solicitation
blockers: This vehicle is explicitly an SDVOSB set-aside and requires qualification under that program for prime award.
The DCE contains extensive scored qualification, cybersecurity/supply-chain, reporting and contract-vehicle requirements well beyond a lean one-off SPM tender.
unknowns: No evidence in the tender-engine bidder profile establishes SPM as an eligible SDVOSB prime.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Potentially broad services, but the mandatory socioeconomic vehicle gate and heavy IDIQ qualification make it non-actionable for SPM on current evidence.

confirmed_supergreens.title: R--Region 6 Superfund Technical Assessment and Response Team (START) IV
blockers: The recovered DCE is a bridge justification for other than full and open competition covering July 2023-January 2024, not a current open competitive solicitation.
Mission scope is EPA Superfund emergency technical assessment/response, not SPM's lean digital/creative/broker core.
confirmed_supergreens.why: The hot queue treated substantive historical acquisition paperwork as live bid evidence.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Patient lifts and Installation
blockers: DCE is an only-one-responsible-source restricted-competition justification for Guldmann patient-lift equipment and installation.
Scope requires medical patient-lift hardware, structural installation/load testing and safe-patient-handling compliance, not SPM's lean core.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Medical equipment installation plus restricted-source procurement; not realistically executable by SPM as prime.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Jamaica Strategic Public Sector Transformation
blockers: Recovered material is broad project/procurement-plan context for a World Bank-financed public-sector transformation program, not a specific currently actionable solicitation with a submission deadline.
No specific SPM-fit deliverable, bidder gate set or submission package is established in the evidence.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Project-level procurement context was incorrectly promoted as a bid-ready tender.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Vendor Collaboration - MULTI-CENTER CLINICAL TRIALS OF NOVEL THERAPIES FOR PATIENTS WITH WELL CHARACTERIZED GASTROPARESIS
blockers: The DCE explicitly says this is not a procurement contract or grant for goods/services and that NIDDK provides no funds to selected collaborators.
It seeks clinical-research collaborators contributing therapeutic agents, devices, laboratory capability and research funding/resources.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Not a revenue tender at all; it is a clinical research collaboration opportunity.

confirmed_supergreens.title: J065--Zeiss Microscope Maintenance - NWI
blockers: Authoritative justification says maintenance must be performed by Zeiss-certified field engineers and identifies PROAIM as the only authorized Zeiss representative accepted for service/repair labor.
Recovered award material names PROAIM AMERICAS, LLC as awardee on 2026-08-14.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Already-awarded/single-source manufacturer-authorized maintenance, not a live SPM opportunity.

blockers: Applicant must provide production-representative explosive-trace-detection systems meeting TSA detection/functional standards and pass certification/qualification testing.
DCE contains classified/SSI handling, facility/personnel clearance and DD Form 254 requirements where applicable.
This is specialized security-screening hardware qualification, not an SPM service or brokerable generic supply tender.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Hard technical/security qualification makes this an obvious false positive.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Ireland – Computer support services – ICT services for the Operation and Maintenance of the Waters of LIFE Web Portal and Smart Phone Application
confirmed_supergreens.buyer: Department of Housing Local Government and Heritage
unknowns: SPM must confirm that its current insurance arrangements can meet the exact policy levels required by paragraph 2.21.1 or arrange compliant cover if awarded.

SPM must evidence a credible delivery team for the existing Go backend, web management dashboard and Flutter mobile application across the contract term; subcontracting/consortium is expressly available if specialist capacity is needed.
SPM must provide acceptable Irish tax-clearance evidence prior to award.
The existing system takeover and ongoing security/support obligations should be technically scoped before pricing to avoid underestimating maintenance effort.
confirmed_supergreens.why: This is a live, authoritative and unusually strong SPM-fit ICT maintenance opportunity. The DCE resolves the true tender deadline to 18 September 2026 at 17:00, while 11 September is only the query deadline. The contract is capped at EUR 80k, the turnover selection criterion is explicitly N/A, no numeric minimum prior-reference or named-certification threshold was identified, and consortium/subcontracting is permitted. The work directly covers a Go backend, web dashboard and Flutter mobile app with maintenance, security, bug-fixing, compatibility and testing. Bidder-specific insurance, tax and delivery-capacity evidence prevent FINAL_SUPER_GREEN but do not constitute an established hard blocker to GREEN.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Provision of a Single Party Framework for the ongoing support, maintenance, and development of YourSpace Portals, associated websites, associated systems and associated services.
unknowns: Whether SPM alone meets EUR 100k turnover in each of the last three financial years
Whether SPM/partners can evidence three comparable contracts at the required scale
Whether required insurance levels or broker confirmations can be arranged
Whether two EU/EEA hosting facilities and required resources can be demonstrated
confirmed_supergreens.why: Excellent digital scope but the qualification burden is material. Viable as partner/consortium/reliance route if turnover, three comparable references, hosting and insurance gates can be covered; not a solo supergreen on current evidence.

confirmed_supergreens.why: Strategically relevant web work but operationally enterprise-heavy and reference-driven. Three detailed Magnolia references determine selection into the top five; substantial cloud/security/operations burden makes this partner-heavy rather than lean-direct.

confirmed_supergreens.title: BPA - Pipe, Hose & Tubing PSC 4710, 4720, 4730
unknowns: Authoritative current submission timing is not resolved from the recovered DCE.
SPM has not evidenced relevant federal past performance or a compliant pipe/hose/tubing supplier route.
Domestic-content/origin and other federal supply clauses require item-level supplier validation.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Not a native SPM service, but unlike the other hot items it is potentially brokerable commodity supply. Keep only as a supplier/middleman investigation, not as a GREEN bid.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Defense Logistics Information Research (DLIR)
blockers: Retrieved authoritative material repeatedly states a 2021 BAA closing date while the live notice metadata says 2026-09-01; current submission authority is not reconciled.
The BAA is defense logistics R&D with technical/scientific review, detailed cost realism, DCAA/accounting representations and research-team expectations rather than a lean SPM service procurement.
Relevant prior research, technical papers, key personnel and detailed cost structure are integral to evaluation.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Interesting AI/RPA language produced a semantic false positive, but the current DCE evidence is both temporally conflicted and qualification-heavy defense R&D.

confirmed_supergreens.title: ULTRA-BROADBAND TERAHERTZ RADIO DEVELOPMENT
blockers: Advanced terahertz radio hardware/R&D program is not a lean SPM delivery scope.
DCE states the BAA is closed to foreign participation except limited fundamental-research exceptions and contains foreign-national/FOCI controls.
Security-risk review, senior/key-person disclosures and scientific/technical capability are material requirements.
confirmed_supergreens.why: A live open BAA, but fundamentally the wrong bidder and technical profile for SPM.

confirmed_supergreens.title: One Acquisition Solution for Integrated Services Plus (OASIS+) Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) Set-Aside Continuously Open Solicitation
blockers: This vehicle is explicitly an SDVOSB set-aside and requires qualification under that program for prime award.
The DCE contains extensive scored qualification, cybersecurity/supply-chain, reporting and contract-vehicle requirements well beyond a lean one-off SPM tender.
unknowns: No evidence in the tender-engine bidder profile establishes SPM as an eligible SDVOSB prime.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Potentially broad services, but the mandatory socioeconomic vehicle gate and heavy IDIQ qualification make it non-actionable for SPM on current evidence.

confirmed_supergreens.title: R--Region 6 Superfund Technical Assessment and Response Team (START) IV
blockers: The recovered DCE is a bridge justification for other than full and open competition covering July 2023-January 2024, not a current open competitive solicitation.
Mission scope is EPA Superfund emergency technical assessment/response, not SPM's lean digital/creative/broker core.
confirmed_supergreens.why: The hot queue treated substantive historical acquisition paperwork as live bid evidence.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Patient lifts and Installation
blockers: DCE is an only-one-responsible-source restricted-competition justification for Guldmann patient-lift equipment and installation.
Scope requires medical patient-lift hardware, structural installation/load testing and safe-patient-handling compliance, not SPM's lean core.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Medical equipment installation plus restricted-source procurement; not realistically executable by SPM as prime.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Jamaica Strategic Public Sector Transformation
blockers: Recovered material is broad project/procurement-plan context for a World Bank-financed public-sector transformation program, not a specific currently actionable solicitation with a submission deadline.
No specific SPM-fit deliverable, bidder gate set or submission package is established in the evidence.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Project-level procurement context was incorrectly promoted as a bid-ready tender.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Vendor Collaboration - MULTI-CENTER CLINICAL TRIALS OF NOVEL THERAPIES FOR PATIENTS WITH WELL CHARACTERIZED GASTROPARESIS

confirmed_supergreens.why: Already-awarded/single-source manufacturer-authorized maintenance, not a live SPM opportunity.

unknowns: Whether SPM/partners have three sufficiently strong Magnolia CMS references

Whether insurance requirements can be met

confirmed_supergreens.title: BPA - Pipe, Hose & Tubing PSC 4710, 4720, 4730
unknowns: Authoritative current submission timing is not resolved from the recovered DCE.
SPM has not evidenced relevant federal past performance or a compliant pipe/hose/tubing supplier route.
Domestic-content/origin and other federal supply clauses require item-level supplier validation.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Not a native SPM service, but unlike the other hot items it is potentially brokerable commodity supply. Keep only as a supplier/middleman investigation, not as a GREEN bid.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Defense Logistics Information Research (DLIR)
blockers: Retrieved authoritative material repeatedly states a 2021 BAA closing date while the live notice metadata says 2026-09-01; current submission authority is not reconciled.
The BAA is defense logistics R&D with technical/scientific review, detailed cost realism, DCAA/accounting representations and research-team expectations rather than a lean SPM service procurement.
Relevant prior research, technical papers, key personnel and detailed cost structure are integral to evaluation.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Interesting AI/RPA language produced a semantic false positive, but the current DCE evidence is both temporally conflicted and qualification-heavy defense R&D.

confirmed_supergreens.title: ULTRA-BROADBAND TERAHERTZ RADIO DEVELOPMENT
blockers: Advanced terahertz radio hardware/R&D program is not a lean SPM delivery scope.
DCE states the BAA is closed to foreign participation except limited fundamental-research exceptions and contains foreign-national/FOCI controls.
Security-risk review, senior/key-person disclosures and scientific/technical capability are material requirements.
confirmed_supergreens.why: A live open BAA, but fundamentally the wrong bidder and technical profile for SPM.

confirmed_supergreens.title: One Acquisition Solution for Integrated Services Plus (OASIS+) Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) Set-Aside Continuously Open Solicitation
blockers: This vehicle is explicitly an SDVOSB set-aside and requires qualification under that program for prime award.
The DCE contains extensive scored qualification, cybersecurity/supply-chain, reporting and contract-vehicle requirements well beyond a lean one-off SPM tender.
unknowns: No evidence in the tender-engine bidder profile establishes SPM as an eligible SDVOSB prime.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Potentially broad services, but the mandatory socioeconomic vehicle gate and heavy IDIQ qualification make it non-actionable for SPM on current evidence.

confirmed_supergreens.title: R--Region 6 Superfund Technical Assessment and Response Team (START) IV
blockers: The recovered DCE is a bridge justification for other than full and open competition covering July 2023-January 2024, not a current open competitive solicitation.
Mission scope is EPA Superfund emergency technical assessment/response, not SPM's lean digital/creative/broker core.
confirmed_supergreens.why: The hot queue treated substantive historical acquisition paperwork as live bid evidence.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Patient lifts and Installation
blockers: DCE is an only-one-responsible-source restricted-competition justification for Guldmann patient-lift equipment and installation.
Scope requires medical patient-lift hardware, structural installation/load testing and safe-patient-handling compliance, not SPM's lean core.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Medical equipment installation plus restricted-source procurement; not realistically executable by SPM as prime.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Jamaica Strategic Public Sector Transformation
blockers: Recovered material is broad project/procurement-plan context for a World Bank-financed public-sector transformation program, not a specific currently actionable solicitation with a submission deadline.
No specific SPM-fit deliverable, bidder gate set or submission package is established in the evidence.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Project-level procurement context was incorrectly promoted as a bid-ready tender.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Vendor Collaboration - MULTI-CENTER CLINICAL TRIALS OF NOVEL THERAPIES FOR PATIENTS WITH WELL CHARACTERIZED GASTROPARESIS
blockers: The DCE explicitly says this is not a procurement contract or grant for goods/services and that NIDDK provides no funds to selected collaborators.
It seeks clinical-research collaborators contributing therapeutic agents, devices, laboratory capability and research funding/resources.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Not a revenue tender at all; it is a clinical research collaboration opportunity.

confirmed_supergreens.title: J065--Zeiss Microscope Maintenance - NWI
blockers: Authoritative justification says maintenance must be performed by Zeiss-certified field engineers and identifies PROAIM as the only authorized Zeiss representative accepted for service/repair labor.
Recovered award material names PROAIM AMERICAS, LLC as awardee on 2026-08-14.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Already-awarded/single-source manufacturer-authorized maintenance, not a live SPM opportunity.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Explosive Trace Detection (ETD) Qualified Products List (QPL)
blockers: Applicant must provide production-representative explosive-trace-detection systems meeting TSA detection/functional standards and pass certification/qualification testing.
DCE contains classified/SSI handling, facility/personnel clearance and DD Form 254 requirements where applicable.
This is specialized security-screening hardware qualification, not an SPM service or brokerable generic supply tender.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Hard technical/security qualification makes this an obvious false positive.

Wenn der Lieferant sich auch beim Einreichen von Offerten vertreten lassen will, muss er für jeden Auftrag dem externen Vertreter eine Vollmacht erteilen. Diese Vollmacht ist der Offerte beizufügen. Ein Lieferant möchte auf die Mittel einer anderen Wirtschaftseinheit zurückgreifen (wie im Königlichen Erlass vom 18. Juni 2017, Artikel 72§1, vorgesehen). Ein Lieferant kann einen Qualifizierungsantrag stellen und für die Qualifizierungskriterien, die Anforderungen in Bezug auf die wirtschaftliche, finanzielle oder technische Leistungsfähigkeit sowie berufliche Befähigung enthalten (3.3.2 und 3.3.3), die Kapazitäten anderer Wirtschaftseinheiten in Anspruch nehmen. Mit anderer Wirtschaftseinheit ist eine andere (natürliche oder juristische) Person als der Lieferant selbst gemeint. Möchte ein Lieferant die Mittel einer anderen Wirtschaftseinheit in Anspruch nehmen, so gibt er dies in der Frage in Teil II C der EEE an. Möchte ein Lieferant die Mittel einer anderen Wirtschaftseinheit in Anspruch nehmen, so muss er zusätzlich zu einer EEE diese Wirtschaftseinheit veranlassen, den Abschnitt „Leistungsfähigkeit Dritter“ in Anhang 3 auszufüllen. Ohne diese Anlage kann der Lieferant eine solche Leistungsfähigkeit nicht in Anspruch nehmen. Unter Punkt 2 des Fragebogens in Anlage 1 muss angegeben werden, für welchen Teil des Auftrags diese Leistungsfähigkeit in Anspruch genommen wird. Duration of a supplier’s qualification A supplier's qualification is valid for a term of 5 years. After the 5-year period, the qualification may be extended for the same period after the administrative and/or technical files are updated. Infrabel Procurement sends the supplier an invitation in this regard about 6 months before the qualification's expiry date. The supplier shall submit the new administrative and/or technical file within 2 months. If the supplier does not take timely action, it runs the risk that its qualification extension is not completed before expiry date. Infrabel reserves the right to perform an audit, if this is deemed necessary, before extending the qualification. If these updated files and possible audit show that the supplier still meets the qualification conditions/criteria, the qualification of the supplier concerned will be renewed. The qualified supplier must continue to meet all qualification conditions/criteria throughout the qualification period. confirmed_supergreens.title: Ireland – Computer support services – ICT services for the Operation and Maintenance of the Waters of LIFE Web Portal and Smart Phone Application
confirmed_supergreens.buyer: Department of Housing Local Government and Heritage
unknowns: SPM must confirm that its current insurance arrangements can meet the exact policy levels required by paragraph 2.21.1 or arrange compliant cover if awarded.

SPM must evidence a credible delivery team for the existing Go backend, web management dashboard and Flutter mobile application across the contract term; subcontracting/consortium is expressly available if specialist capacity is needed.
SPM must provide acceptable Irish tax-clearance evidence prior to award.
The existing system takeover and ongoing security/support obligations should be technically scoped before pricing to avoid underestimating maintenance effort.
confirmed_supergreens.why: This is a live, authoritative and unusually strong SPM-fit ICT maintenance opportunity. The DCE resolves the true tender deadline to 18 September 2026 at 17:00, while 11 September is only the query deadline. The contract is capped at EUR 80k, the turnover selection criterion is explicitly N/A, no numeric minimum prior-reference or named-certification threshold was identified, and consortium/subcontracting is permitted. The work directly covers a Go backend, web dashboard and Flutter mobile app with maintenance, security, bug-fixing, compatibility and testing. Bidder-specific insurance, tax and delivery-capacity evidence prevent FINAL_SUPER_GREEN but do not constitute an established hard blocker to GREEN.

confirmed_supergreens.title: France – Motion picture and video services – Prestations de captation vidéo, de production audiovisuelle (avec ou sans scénarisation), de post-production et de réalisation de supports vidéo accessibles pour le compte de l’université de Montpellier Paul-Valéry
unknowns: Exact minimum level, if any, attached to professional references/capacity must be confirmed
SPM needs a credible local/on-site capture crew and civil-liability insurance evidence
confirmed_supergreens.why: Strong new SPM-fit audiovisual opportunity. Two lots cover video capture/production and accessible video; the scope expressly includes post-production, transfer of rushes and all versions, and motion-design/interactive integration. Participation is not reserved, capacity from other economic operators may be relied upon with written commitment, electronic tender submission is supported and payment is on a 30-day university cycle. Physical capture in Herault and remaining bidder-capacity proof keep it just below GREEN.

confirmed_supergreens.title: France – Graphic design services – Réalisation, impression et routage du journal interne Filieris
unknowns: Exact lot-level technical/reference requirements need final verification
Compliant printing/routing supplier, pricing and delivery economics are not yet evidenced
confirmed_supergreens.why: Directly brokerable design, printing and routing opportunity with a EUR 185,000 procedure value. The notice shows an open procedure with two lots and a EUR 55,000 maximum framework value for one exposed lot. This is commercially attractive, but supplier execution and exact qualification gates remain material dependencies.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Ireland – Website and App Accessibility Audit Solution
confirmed_supergreens.why: EUR 350k hosted Website and App Accessibility Audit Platform is a strong SPM-fit open procedure. DCE resolves the true deadline to 18 September 2026 at noon, but extracted selection evidence does not expose exact financial/reference thresholds, so missing gates cannot be treated as PASS.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Website and App Accessibility Audit Solution
confirmed_supergreens.why: National eTenders lane of the same EUR 350k Accessibility Audit Platform. Authoritative DCE deadline is 18 September 2026 at noon. Same unresolved mandatory selection gates as the TED lane.

confirmed_supergreens.title: France – Printing services – Prestations d’impression pour l’Institut de France
unknowns: Exact technical/reference and sample requirements per lot need final verification
Compliant print supplier, BPU economics and delivery logistics are not yet locked
confirmed_supergreens.why: Open two-lot printing framework with unit-price ordering and long bid runway. The DCE asks for turnover information for up to the last three available financial years and technical-capacity declarations, but the compact evidence does not establish a disqualifying numeric turnover threshold. Strong print-broker candidate, but supplier economics and exact lot gates remain unresolved.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Design, layout and printing of Department of Agriculture five-year report
confirmed_supergreens.why: Hidden gem: DCE explicitly asks for design, layout and printing of the five-year report. Directly brokerable with AI/design plus print subcontractor. Main friction is South African administration and apparent physical quotation-box submission in Pretoria.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Belgium – Graphic design services – Provision of graphic design services and image-related services
unknowns: Exact minimum-turnover amount and lot-specific financial-capacity proof must be fully reconciled
SPM/partners must demonstrate the required professional capacity for the selected lot
confirmed_supergreens.why: Very strong creative/AI-assisted fit and the DCE does not prohibit AI use, but the European Parliament imposes a minimum financial/economic capacity per lot and professional-capacity evidence. Those gates are material and are not yet proven for SPM alone.

confirmed_supergreens.title: AI Technologies for Procurement Modernization Commercial Solutions Opening
confirmed_supergreens.why: DHS CSO directly targets AI procurement modernization, including procurement news monitoring, sentiment, alerts and lifecycle visibility. Strategically excellent fit with the tender engine, but federal registration, cybersecurity and business-viability requirements are material.

confirmed_supergreens.title: France – Impression des supports de communication de Beaucaire Terre d'Argence
confirmed_supergreens.why: Straight printing of communication supports. Strong middleman/print-broker lane with long runway, but compact gate extraction is insufficient to declare GREEN before volumes, samples/references and delivery requirements are checked.

confirmed_supergreens.title: France – Graphic design services – Prestations de conseil en communication, conception graphique et editoriale, fabrication de supports et totems de communication, dans le cadre du projet ecocampus
unknowns: Exact lot-specific technical/reference minimums and fabrication logistics remain to be proven
SPM needs a credible physical fabrication/installation route for supports and totems
confirmed_supergreens.why: Open French framework combining communication advice, graphic/editorial design and fabrication. The framework has no minimum order amount and can run for one year with up to three renewals. Creative work is a strong fit, but physical-support/totem delivery and reference/capacity evidence prevent a clean GREEN today.

confirmed_supergreens.title: RFP-HO-06-2026 – Brand Strategist
confirmed_supergreens.why: Actual DCE is a six-month SAHRC Brand Strategist engagement covering research/survey, brand strategy, repositioning, messaging and social-media monitoring/management. Excellent creative/AI-assisted scope, but bidder track record remains a gate.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Poland – Modernizacja systemów ochrony środowiska z API i udostępnieniem danych
confirmed_supergreens.why: Substantive modernization of multiple environmental systems with REST APIs, data publication, security/accessibility standards and buyer-provided VMware infrastructure. Strong software lane; local technical/reference partner prudent.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Ireland – Unit4 ERP Implementation, Hypercare And Application Support Services
confirmed_supergreens.why: EUR 200k ERP implementation/support. DCE explicitly encourages SMEs to form relationships with other SMEs/larger enterprises and requires migration, testing, cutover, API, training and knowledge-transfer deliverables. Strong partnerable opportunity with a Unit4 implementer.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Ireland – World wide web (www) site design services – Web development support services - 210901/7828
unknowns: Authoritative submission deadline still requires reconciliation
SPM alone has not evidenced the required qualifying web-project reference and complete key-profile set
confirmed_supergreens.why: Excellent web-development scope, but the DCE requires a qualifying completed web application/project of at least EUR 25,000 and specified personnel profiles, including a web project manager with at least three years of relevant experience and C1 English. Joint tendering, subcontracting and reliance on other entities are expressly available, making this a credible partner route rather than a lean-direct GREEN.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Belgium – Développement d’un outil de prévision et de notification de risques de crues soudaines
unknowns: Whether SPM/partner can evidence qualifying EUR 100k comparable missions
confirmed_supergreens.why: Direct software scope for SPW, but DCE requires recent qualifying references with a minimum level of EUR 100k excl. VAT per mission and integration with WISKI REST, GESTIA IAM/OIDC-OAuth and SPW infrastructure. Partnerable, not lean-direct on present bidder evidence.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Belgium – Supply chain traceability services and forced labour risk detection pilots
confirmed_supergreens.why: EUR 425k European Commission pilot is digitally aligned and geographically attractive. Domain expertise, data sources, pilot methodology and qualification thresholds need deeper verification before GREEN.

confirmed_supergreens.title: TEGUC communications / outreach requirement
confirmed_supergreens.why: Communications/outreach scope is commercially brokerable, but execution includes local physical media, community relationships and distribution. A local field partner and US federal eligibility are essential.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Ireland – Internet services – Trócaire RFT Website Development and Maintenance Services
unknowns: TED and national eTenders deadline metadata require reconciliation
SPM alone has not evidenced the required recent website references, large e-commerce/Salesforce experience and insurance
confirmed_supergreens.why: Native WordPress/web-maintenance scope, but the RFT asks for at least three websites designed and delivered in the last 24 months with actual references, plus large e-commerce/payment-provider and heavily customised Salesforce integration experience, multiple environments, security and adequate insurance. Partnerable, not lean-direct.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Germany – Wartung, Support und Weiterentwicklung der bestehenden Jitsi-Umgebung bei IT.NRW
confirmed_supergreens.why: Real software maintenance and development scope around an existing Jitsi environment. This is technically partnerable but specialist operations, references and service-level capability are not yet proven for SPM.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Ireland – 9191 INTERNAL COMMUNICATIONS PLATFORM
confirmed_supergreens.why: EUR 850k enterprise platform is a real software opportunity, but it is a PQQ with audited accounts/turnover history and only up to five pre-qualified applicants proceeding to tender. Better as consortium/product-vendor route.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Germany – ISGA-Portal Weiterentwicklung und Support
confirmed_supergreens.why: Genuine portal development/support procurement, but bidder financial and reference evidence remains unresolved and the deadline is very close. Not safe to call GREEN without those gates.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Ireland – Contract Lifecycle Management solution for An Post
confirmed_supergreens.why: Real enterprise CLM implementation/support with integrations to ERP, procurement/finance, IAM, DMS, e-signature and CRM. Strong software fit but enterprise-product, security and implementation evidence make it a vendor/partner route rather than lean-direct.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Provision of a Single Party Framework for the ongoing support, maintenance, and development of YourSpace Portals, associated websites, associated systems and associated services.
unknowns: Whether SPM alone meets EUR 100k turnover in each of the last three financial years
Whether SPM/partners can evidence three comparable contracts at the required scale
Whether required insurance levels or broker confirmations can be arranged
Whether two EU/EEA hosting facilities and required resources can be demonstrated
confirmed_supergreens.why: Excellent digital scope but the qualification burden is material. Viable as partner/consortium/reliance route if turnover, three comparable references, hosting and insurance gates can be covered; not a solo supergreen on current evidence.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Belgium – Facility Management Information System
confirmed_supergreens.why: Real enterprise FMIS implementation opportunity in Belgium. It fits a software-vendor/integrator strategy, but current evidence does not support a lean SPM-direct bid.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Ireland – Veterinary Clinical Skills, Simulation and Immersive Learning Platform
confirmed_supergreens.why: TED lane of the same ATU immersive-learning procurement already identified through the national eTenders lane. High-value and relevant but PQQ/reference/insurance heavy, so partner-only on present evidence.

confirmed_supergreens.title: 369-26 Veterinary Clinical Skills, Simulation and Immersive Learning Platform
confirmed_supergreens.why: High-value immersive-learning scope, but DCE is PQQ/reference driven and requires major insurance levels including EUR 13m employer, EUR 6.5m public/product and EUR 3m professional indemnity. Partner-heavy.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Manufacturing Execution System software requirement
confirmed_supergreens.why: The DCE calls for a pre-existing MES compatible with specified additive-manufacturing equipment, including API/emulator/support capability. This is a software resale/integration opportunity only if a compliant commercial product partner is found.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Germany – Erneuerung Citrix NetScaler WAF im SAP-Kontext
confirmed_supergreens.why: Vendor-specific Citrix hardware/licensing plus 60 months support. DCE requires three references including one university/public-sector reference, SAP-on-NetScaler experience, employee profiles and certification evidence. Reseller/integrator route only.

confirmed_supergreens.title: VMware / Broadcom licensing and support procurement
confirmed_supergreens.why: High-value licensing/support opportunity, but it is channel-dependent. SPM should treat it as a resale play only after an authorized partner and viable margin are secured.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Germany – IT services: consulting, software development, Internet and support – Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung Websites
confirmed_supergreens.buyer: Kulturveranstaltungen des Bundes in Berlin GmbH (KBB GmbH)
unknowns: Whether SPM/partners have three sufficiently strong Magnolia CMS references
Whether required ISMS/security capability and operational staffing can be demonstrated
Whether insurance requirements can be met
confirmed_supergreens.why: Strategically relevant web work but operationally enterprise-heavy and reference-driven. Three detailed Magnolia references determine selection into the top five; substantial cloud/security/operations burden makes this partner-heavy rather than lean-direct.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Belgium – GitLab Enterprise Premium Self-Managed licensing
confirmed_supergreens.why: Potentially simple licensing resale, but profitability and eligibility depend on an authorized channel and supplier pricing. Keep as reseller investigation, not a direct GREEN.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Belgium – Oracle licensing/support procurement for SPW
confirmed_supergreens.why: Large licensing opportunity but entirely dependent on Oracle channel eligibility and economics. Keep as a commercial partner play rather than a software-delivery GREEN.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Poland – software support / maintenance requirement
confirmed_supergreens.why: Potential reseller/support lane, but authorization and local service requirements remain decisive. No direct SPM capability should be inferred.

confirmed_supergreens.title: BPA - Pipe, Hose & Tubing PSC 4710, 4720, 4730
unknowns: Authoritative current submission timing is not resolved from the recovered DCE.
SPM has not evidenced relevant federal past performance or a compliant pipe/hose/tubing supplier route.
Domestic-content/origin and other federal supply clauses require item-level supplier validation.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Not a native SPM service, but unlike the other hot items it is potentially brokerable commodity supply. Keep only as a supplier/middleman investigation, not as a GREEN bid.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Defense Logistics Information Research (DLIR)
blockers: Retrieved authoritative material repeatedly states a 2021 BAA closing date while the live notice metadata says 2026-09-01; current submission authority is not reconciled.
The BAA is defense logistics R&D with technical/scientific review, detailed cost realism, DCAA/accounting representations and research-team expectations rather than a lean SPM service procurement.
Relevant prior research, technical papers, key personnel and detailed cost structure are integral to evaluation.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Interesting AI/RPA language produced a semantic false positive, but the current DCE evidence is both temporally conflicted and qualification-heavy defense R&D.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Iziko Museums display infrastructure fabrication and installation
blockers: Physical fabrication/installation scope
confirmed_supergreens.why: False positive: DCE is fabrication and installation of exhibition display infrastructure in Cape Town rather than graphic design alone.

confirmed_supergreens.title: SENT/022/2026-27
blockers: Scope mismatch: lighting project
Reference-heavy local delivery
confirmed_supergreens.why: False positive: DCE concerns a lighting project and scores prior related lighting projects via reference letters/completion certificates. It is not website development.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Predictive Lake Analytics Nextgen eXchange Services (PLANXS)
blockers: Non-competitive extension / incumbent-specific action
confirmed_supergreens.why: DCE is a justification for exception to fair opportunity / non-competitive extension of the current PLANXS award, not an open new SPM opportunity.

confirmed_supergreens.title: ULTRA-BROADBAND TERAHERTZ RADIO DEVELOPMENT
blockers: Advanced terahertz radio hardware/R&D program is not a lean SPM delivery scope.
DCE states the BAA is closed to foreign participation except limited fundamental-research exceptions and contains foreign-national/FOCI controls.
Security-risk review, senior/key-person disclosures and scientific/technical capability are material requirements.
confirmed_supergreens.why: A live open BAA, but fundamentally the wrong bidder and technical profile for SPM.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Physical Security Services, Coos Bay District BLM
blockers: Physical guard/security-service scope
Licensing and local workforce requirements
confirmed_supergreens.why: False semantic fit. This is a physical security-services procurement, not a software-development opportunity suitable for lean SPM execution.

confirmed_supergreens.title: One Acquisition Solution for Integrated Services Plus (OASIS+) Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) Set-Aside Continuously Open Solicitation
blockers: This vehicle is explicitly an SDVOSB set-aside and requires qualification under that program for prime award.
The DCE contains extensive scored qualification, cybersecurity/supply-chain, reporting and contract-vehicle requirements well beyond a lean one-off SPM tender.
unknowns: No evidence in the tender-engine bidder profile establishes SPM as an eligible SDVOSB prime.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Potentially broad services, but the mandatory socioeconomic vehicle gate and heavy IDIQ qualification make it non-actionable for SPM on current evidence.

confirmed_supergreens.title: R--Region 6 Superfund Technical Assessment and Response Team (START) IV
blockers: The recovered DCE is a bridge justification for other than full and open competition covering July 2023-January 2024, not a current open competitive solicitation.
Mission scope is EPA Superfund emergency technical assessment/response, not SPM's lean digital/creative/broker core.
confirmed_supergreens.why: The hot queue treated substantive historical acquisition paperwork as live bid evidence.

confirmed_supergreens.title: France – Co-commissariat aux comptes France Travail
blockers: Regulated statutory-audit mandate
Professional qualification requirement outside SPM model
confirmed_supergreens.why: This is a regulated statutory audit mandate, not a generic IT/services opportunity. The semantic IT-services hit is not commercially relevant for SPM.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Malta – medical X-ray equipment procurement
blockers: Specialized regulated medical-equipment scope
confirmed_supergreens.why: Physical regulated medical-equipment supply with specialist compliance requirements. Not a realistic SPM lean/broker target from current evidence.

confirmed_supergreens.title: R/V Caretta Shipyard Repairs
blockers: Shipyard physical repair scope
confirmed_supergreens.why: False positive: authoritative DCE is shipyard repair work, not a web-portal project.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Jamaica Strategic Public Sector Transformation
blockers: Recovered material is broad project/procurement-plan context for a World Bank-financed public-sector transformation program, not a specific currently actionable solicitation with a submission deadline.
No specific SPM-fit deliverable, bidder gate set or submission package is established in the evidence.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Project-level procurement context was incorrectly promoted as a bid-ready tender.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Vendor Collaboration - MULTI-CENTER CLINICAL TRIALS OF NOVEL THERAPIES FOR PATIENTS WITH WELL CHARACTERIZED GASTROPARESIS
blockers: The DCE explicitly says this is not a procurement contract or grant for goods/services and that NIDDK provides no funds to selected collaborators.
It seeks clinical-research collaborators contributing therapeutic agents, devices, laboratory capability and research funding/resources.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Not a revenue tender at all; it is a clinical research collaboration opportunity.

confirmed_supergreens.title: J065--Zeiss Microscope Maintenance - NWI
blockers: Authoritative justification says maintenance must be performed by Zeiss-certified field engineers and identifies PROAIM as the only authorized Zeiss representative accepted for service/repair labor.
Recovered award material names PROAIM AMERICAS, LLC as awardee on 2026-08-14.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Already-awarded/single-source manufacturer-authorized maintenance, not a live SPM opportunity.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Explosive Trace Detection (ETD) Qualified Products List (QPL)
blockers: Applicant must provide production-representative explosive-trace-detection systems meeting TSA detection/functional standards and pass certification/qualification testing.
DCE contains classified/SSI handling, facility/personnel clearance and DD Form 254 requirements where applicable.
This is specialized security-screening hardware qualification, not an SPM service or brokerable generic supply tender.
confirmed_supergreens.why: Hard technical/security qualification makes this an obvious false positive.

row.summary: Authoritative DCE is gate-ready. Final business adjudication is intentionally delegated to the persistent GPT Web review bank; GitHub Actions performs no remote LLM/API adjudication.

evidence_quality.rule: DOWNLOADED_PUBLIC is transport success only. Gate review requires semantic candidate specificity or exact trusted official attachment provenance; publication notice PDFs are never promoted. Provenance proves authority, not eligibility, and mandatory-gate UNKNOWN remains UNKNOWN.

deadline.rule: Only dates locally attached to tender/bid/quotation submission or requests-to-participate language can automatically resolve bid timing. Query/clarification dates are never accepted as submission deadlines. Missing/ambiguous submission evidence remains review-required before FINAL_SUPER_GREEN.
