confirmed_supergreens.title: Ireland – Computer support services – ICT services for the Operation and Maintenance of the Waters of LIFE Web Portal and Smart Phone Application
confirmed_supergreens.buyer: Department of Housing Local Government and Heritage
unknowns: SPM must confirm that its current insurance arrangements can meet the exact policy levels required by paragraph 2.21.1 or arrange compliant cover if awarded.

SPM must evidence a credible delivery team for the existing Go backend, web management dashboard and Flutter mobile application across the contract term; subcontracting/consortium is expressly available if specialist capacity is needed.
SPM must provide acceptable Irish tax-clearance evidence prior to award.
The existing system takeover and ongoing security/support obligations should be technically scoped before pricing to avoid underestimating maintenance effort.
confirmed_supergreens.why: This is a live, authoritative and unusually strong SPM-fit ICT maintenance opportunity. The DCE resolves the true tender deadline to 18 September 2026 at 17:00, while 11 September is only the query deadline. The contract is capped at EUR 80k, the turnover selection criterion is explicitly N/A, no numeric minimum prior-reference or named-certification threshold was identified, and consortium/subcontracting is permitted. The work directly covers a Go backend, web dashboard and Flutter mobile app with maintenance, security, bug-fixing, compatibility and testing. Bidder-specific insurance, tax and delivery-capacity evidence prevent FINAL_SUPER_GREEN but do not constitute an established hard blocker to GREEN.

confirmed_supergreens.title: France – Motion picture and video services – Prestations de captation vidéo, de production audiovisuelle (avec ou sans scénarisation), de post-production et de réalisation de supports vidéo accessibles pour le compte de l’université de Montpellier Paul-Valéry
unknowns: Exact minimum level, if any, attached to professional references/capacity must be confirmed
SPM needs a credible local/on-site capture crew and civil-liability insurance evidence
confirmed_supergreens.why: Strong new SPM-fit audiovisual opportunity. Two lots cover video capture/production and accessible video; the scope expressly includes post-production, transfer of rushes and all versions, and motion-design/interactive integration. Participation is not reserved, capacity from other economic operators may be relied upon with written commitment, electronic tender submission is supported and payment is on a 30-day university cycle. Physical capture in Herault and remaining bidder-capacity proof keep it just below GREEN.

confirmed_supergreens.title: France – Graphic design services – Réalisation, impression et routage du journal interne Filieris
unknowns: Exact lot-level technical/reference requirements need final verification
Compliant printing/routing supplier, pricing and delivery economics are not yet evidenced
confirmed_supergreens.why: Directly brokerable design, printing and routing opportunity with a EUR 185,000 procedure value. The notice shows an open procedure with two lots and a EUR 55,000 maximum framework value for one exposed lot. This is commercially attractive, but supplier execution and exact qualification gates remain material dependencies.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Ireland – Website and App Accessibility Audit Solution
confirmed_supergreens.why: EUR 350k hosted Website and App Accessibility Audit Platform is a strong SPM-fit open procedure. DCE resolves the true deadline to 18 September 2026 at noon, but extracted selection evidence does not expose exact financial/reference thresholds, so missing gates cannot be treated as PASS.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Website and App Accessibility Audit Solution
confirmed_supergreens.why: National eTenders lane of the same EUR 350k Accessibility Audit Platform. Authoritative DCE deadline is 18 September 2026 at noon. Same unresolved mandatory selection gates as the TED lane.

confirmed_supergreens.title: France – Printing services – Prestations d’impression pour l’Institut de France
unknowns: Exact technical/reference and sample requirements per lot need final verification
Compliant print supplier, BPU economics and delivery logistics are not yet locked
confirmed_supergreens.why: Open two-lot printing framework with unit-price ordering and long bid runway. The DCE asks for turnover information for up to the last three available financial years and technical-capacity declarations, but the compact evidence does not establish a disqualifying numeric turnover threshold. Strong print-broker candidate, but supplier economics and exact lot gates remain unresolved.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Design, layout and printing of Department of Agriculture five-year report
confirmed_supergreens.why: Hidden gem: DCE explicitly asks for design, layout and printing of the five-year report. Directly brokerable with AI/design plus print subcontractor. Main friction is South African administration and apparent physical quotation-box submission in Pretoria.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Belgium – Graphic design services – Provision of graphic design services and image-related services
unknowns: Exact minimum-turnover amount and lot-specific financial-capacity proof must be fully reconciled
SPM/partners must demonstrate the required professional capacity for the selected lot
confirmed_supergreens.why: Very strong creative/AI-assisted fit and the DCE does not prohibit AI use, but the European Parliament imposes a minimum financial/economic capacity per lot and professional-capacity evidence. Those gates are material and are not yet proven for SPM alone.

confirmed_supergreens.title: AI Technologies for Procurement Modernization Commercial Solutions Opening
confirmed_supergreens.why: DHS CSO directly targets AI procurement modernization, including procurement news monitoring, sentiment, alerts and lifecycle visibility. Strategically excellent fit with the tender engine, but federal registration, cybersecurity and business-viability requirements are material.

confirmed_supergreens.title: France – Impression des supports de communication de Beaucaire Terre d'Argence
confirmed_supergreens.why: Straight printing of communication supports. Strong middleman/print-broker lane with long runway, but compact gate extraction is insufficient to declare GREEN before volumes, samples/references and delivery requirements are checked.

confirmed_supergreens.title: France – Graphic design services – Prestations de conseil en communication, conception graphique et editoriale, fabrication de supports et totems de communication, dans le cadre du projet ecocampus
unknowns: Exact lot-specific technical/reference minimums and fabrication logistics remain to be proven
SPM needs a credible physical fabrication/installation route for supports and totems
confirmed_supergreens.why: Open French framework combining communication advice, graphic/editorial design and fabrication. The framework has no minimum order amount and can run for one year with up to three renewals. Creative work is a strong fit, but physical-support/totem delivery and reference/capacity evidence prevent a clean GREEN today.

confirmed_supergreens.title: RFP-HO-06-2026 – Brand Strategist
confirmed_supergreens.why: Actual DCE is a six-month SAHRC Brand Strategist engagement covering research/survey, brand strategy, repositioning, messaging and social-media monitoring/management. Excellent creative/AI-assisted scope, but bidder track record remains a gate.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Poland – Modernizacja systemów ochrony środowiska z API i udostępnieniem danych
confirmed_supergreens.why: Substantive modernization of multiple environmental systems with REST APIs, data publication, security/accessibility standards and buyer-provided VMware infrastructure. Strong software lane; local technical/reference partner prudent.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Ireland – Unit4 ERP Implementation, Hypercare And Application Support Services
confirmed_supergreens.why: EUR 200k ERP implementation/support. DCE explicitly encourages SMEs to form relationships with other SMEs/larger enterprises and requires migration, testing, cutover, API, training and knowledge-transfer deliverables. Strong partnerable opportunity with a Unit4 implementer.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Ireland – World wide web (www) site design services – Web development support services - 210901/7828
unknowns: Authoritative submission deadline still requires reconciliation
SPM alone has not evidenced the required qualifying web-project reference and complete key-profile set
confirmed_supergreens.why: Excellent web-development scope, but the DCE requires a qualifying completed web application/project of at least EUR 25,000 and specified personnel profiles, including a web project manager with at least three years of relevant experience and C1 English. Joint tendering, subcontracting and reliance on other entities are expressly available, making this a credible partner route rather than a lean-direct GREEN.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Belgium – Développement d’un outil de prévision et de notification de risques de crues soudaines
unknowns: Whether SPM/partner can evidence qualifying EUR 100k comparable missions
confirmed_supergreens.why: Direct software scope for SPW, but DCE requires recent qualifying references with a minimum level of EUR 100k excl. VAT per mission and integration with WISKI REST, GESTIA IAM/OIDC-OAuth and SPW infrastructure. Partnerable, not lean-direct on present bidder evidence.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Belgium – Supply chain traceability services and forced labour risk detection pilots
confirmed_supergreens.why: EUR 425k European Commission pilot is digitally aligned and geographically attractive. Domain expertise, data sources, pilot methodology and qualification thresholds need deeper verification before GREEN.

confirmed_supergreens.title: TEGUC communications / outreach requirement
confirmed_supergreens.why: Communications/outreach scope is commercially brokerable, but execution includes local physical media, community relationships and distribution. A local field partner and US federal eligibility are essential.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Ireland – Internet services – Trócaire RFT Website Development and Maintenance Services
unknowns: TED and national eTenders deadline metadata require reconciliation
SPM alone has not evidenced the required recent website references, large e-commerce/Salesforce experience and insurance
confirmed_supergreens.why: Native WordPress/web-maintenance scope, but the RFT asks for at least three websites designed and delivered in the last 24 months with actual references, plus large e-commerce/payment-provider and heavily customised Salesforce integration experience, multiple environments, security and adequate insurance. Partnerable, not lean-direct.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Germany – Wartung, Support und Weiterentwicklung der bestehenden Jitsi-Umgebung bei IT.NRW
confirmed_supergreens.why: Real software maintenance and development scope around an existing Jitsi environment. This is technically partnerable but specialist operations, references and service-level capability are not yet proven for SPM.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Ireland – 9191 INTERNAL COMMUNICATIONS PLATFORM
confirmed_supergreens.why: EUR 850k enterprise platform is a real software opportunity, but it is a PQQ with audited accounts/turnover history and only up to five pre-qualified applicants proceeding to tender. Better as consortium/product-vendor route.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Germany – ISGA-Portal Weiterentwicklung und Support
confirmed_supergreens.why: Genuine portal development/support procurement, but bidder financial and reference evidence remains unresolved and the deadline is very close. Not safe to call GREEN without those gates.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Ireland – Contract Lifecycle Management solution for An Post
confirmed_supergreens.why: Real enterprise CLM implementation/support with integrations to ERP, procurement/finance, IAM, DMS, e-signature and CRM. Strong software fit but enterprise-product, security and implementation evidence make it a vendor/partner route rather than lean-direct.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Provision of a Single Party Framework for the ongoing support, maintenance, and development of YourSpace Portals, associated websites, associated systems and associated services.
unknowns: Whether SPM alone meets EUR 100k turnover in each of the last three financial years
Whether SPM/partners can evidence three comparable contracts at the required scale
Whether required insurance levels or broker confirmations can be arranged
Whether two EU/EEA hosting facilities and required resources can be demonstrated
confirmed_supergreens.why: Excellent digital scope but the qualification burden is material. Viable as partner/consortium/reliance route if turnover, three comparable references, hosting and insurance gates can be covered; not a solo supergreen on current evidence.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Belgium – Facility Management Information System
confirmed_supergreens.why: Real enterprise FMIS implementation opportunity in Belgium. It fits a software-vendor/integrator strategy, but current evidence does not support a lean SPM-direct bid.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Ireland – Veterinary Clinical Skills, Simulation and Immersive Learning Platform
confirmed_supergreens.why: TED lane of the same ATU immersive-learning procurement already identified through the national eTenders lane. High-value and relevant but PQQ/reference/insurance heavy, so partner-only on present evidence.

confirmed_supergreens.title: 369-26 Veterinary Clinical Skills, Simulation and Immersive Learning Platform
confirmed_supergreens.why: High-value immersive-learning scope, but DCE is PQQ/reference driven and requires major insurance levels including EUR 13m employer, EUR 6.5m public/product and EUR 3m professional indemnity. Partner-heavy.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Manufacturing Execution System software requirement
confirmed_supergreens.why: The DCE calls for a pre-existing MES compatible with specified additive-manufacturing equipment, including API/emulator/support capability. This is a software resale/integration opportunity only if a compliant commercial product partner is found.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Germany – Erneuerung Citrix NetScaler WAF im SAP-Kontext
confirmed_supergreens.why: Vendor-specific Citrix hardware/licensing plus 60 months support. DCE requires three references including one university/public-sector reference, SAP-on-NetScaler experience, employee profiles and certification evidence. Reseller/integrator route only.

confirmed_supergreens.title: VMware / Broadcom licensing and support procurement
confirmed_supergreens.why: High-value licensing/support opportunity, but it is channel-dependent. SPM should treat it as a resale play only after an authorized partner and viable margin are secured.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Germany – IT services: consulting, software development, Internet and support – Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung Websites
confirmed_supergreens.buyer: Kulturveranstaltungen des Bundes in Berlin GmbH (KBB GmbH)
unknowns: Whether SPM/partners have three sufficiently strong Magnolia CMS references

confirmed_supergreens.title: Ireland – Computer support services – ICT services for the Operation and Maintenance of the Waters of LIFE Web Portal and Smart Phone Application
confirmed_supergreens.buyer: Department of Housing Local Government and Heritage
unknowns: SPM must confirm that its current insurance arrangements can meet the exact policy levels required by paragraph 2.21.1 or arrange compliant cover if awarded.

SPM must evidence a credible delivery team for the existing Go backend, web management dashboard and Flutter mobile application across the contract term; subcontracting/consortium is expressly available if specialist capacity is needed.
SPM must provide acceptable Irish tax-clearance evidence prior to award.
The existing system takeover and ongoing security/support obligations should be technically scoped before pricing to avoid underestimating maintenance effort.
confirmed_supergreens.why: This is a live, authoritative and unusually strong SPM-fit ICT maintenance opportunity. The DCE resolves the true tender deadline to 18 September 2026 at 17:00, while 11 September is only the query deadline. The contract is capped at EUR 80k, the turnover selection criterion is explicitly N/A, no numeric minimum prior-reference or named-certification threshold was identified, and consortium/subcontracting is permitted. The work directly covers a Go backend, web dashboard and Flutter mobile app with maintenance, security, bug-fixing, compatibility and testing. Bidder-specific insurance, tax and delivery-capacity evidence prevent FINAL_SUPER_GREEN but do not constitute an established hard blocker to GREEN.

confirmed_supergreens.title: France – Motion picture and video services – Prestations de captation vidéo, de production audiovisuelle (avec ou sans scénarisation), de post-production et de réalisation de supports vidéo accessibles pour le compte de l’université de Montpellier Paul-Valéry
unknowns: Exact minimum level, if any, attached to professional references/capacity must be confirmed
SPM needs a credible local/on-site capture crew and civil-liability insurance evidence

Two lots cover video capture/production and accessible video; the scope expressly includes post-production, transfer of rushes and all versions, and motion-design/interactive integration. Participation is not reserved, capacity from other economic operators may be relied upon with written commitment, electronic tender submission is supported and payment is on a 30-day university cycle. Physical capture in Herault and remaining bidder-capacity proof keep it just below GREEN.
